gnas lugasarang byung gi rgyud kyi rtsa ba'i sabacad bsdus pa rmongs pa'i mun sel bzhugs tres/ / (1)dag snang ye shesadru ba las: gnasalugasarang byung gi rgyud rdo rje'i snying po bzhugasaso/: (10)yab rje bdud 'joms rin po che'i gdung rabs dang 'brel ba'i gnasalugasarang byung gi rgyud kyi bsdus don gas la bshad zla ba'i 'od snang zhes bya ba bzhugs/so/ /lcagasakhung ngag dbang blo bzang gisabartsams/(366)

༄༅/ / gnas lugs rang byung gi rgyud kyi rtsa ba'i sa bcad bsdus pa rmongs pa'i mun sel bzhugs so/ /zab gsang rdzogs pa chen po'i gnas lugs rang byung gi rgyud rngo rje'i snying po 'di 'chad pa la don rnam nga gsum ste/ thog mar dge ba klad kyi don/ bar du dge bgazhung gi don/ tha mar dge ba mjug gi don dang gsum las/ dang po thog mar dge ba klad kyi don la lnga las/ dang po mtshan don ni das snang ye shes sogs/so : gnyis pa mchod par brjod pa ni khyab bdag gdod ma 'i sogs/lo: gsum pa gnang ba zhu ba ni/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sogs/ gso na :bzhi pa brtsams par dam bca' ba ni/ gdod ma'i gnas lugs ka das sogasadu gsol: lnga pa rgyud ji ltar byung ba'i rgyu gleng gzhi ni/ phun sum tshogs pa lngabashad pa dang / rkyen gleng bslang ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ theg mchog rgyal po sogs/ lta ste: phun sum tshogs nga lnga ni/ dus phun sum tshogs pa/ gnasaston pa/ 'khor/ chos phun sum tshogs pa dang lnga'o/ / dang po dus phun sum tshogs pani/ rang byung rka das sogs/ gnyis pa gnas phun sum chogs pa ni gnasarang snang don gyi sogs/ grags pa: gsum pa ston pa phun sum tshogs pa niseng ge'i khri de'i khar sogs 'char ba: bzhi nga 'khor phun sum tshogs nga ni/ston pa de la rang rtsal sogs/ bzhugs : lnga pa chos phun sum tshogs pa ni slar yang nam mkha' rnam par sogs/ bstod: gnyis pa rkyen gleng bslang

cesagasungs so: bar du dge ba gzhung gi don/ gzhi khregs chod dang / lam da rgal bsgom pa gnyis las/ dang po gzhikhregs chod la/ sems rtsal la lam byed pa dang / rig pa rang gi ngo bo la lam byed pa gnyis las/ dang po sems rtsal dran pa bzhi dang / lam rig ngo spyod pa gnyis las/ dang po la lus ngag yid gsum gyi gtso gang che brtags pa/ gnyis pa gzugs dbyibs kha dog la brtags pa/ gsum pa byung gnas 'gro gsum la brtags pa/ bzhi pa sems dran pa bzhi la brtags pa'o/ yang byang chub sems dpa' stong chen mtha' yas pas: kyi ston pa bcom ldan 'das gdul bya rnam par sogs/ kyis bzhag: dang po lus ngag yid gsum la rtags pa ni/ kyai stong chen mtha' yas khyod kyi lus sogs/ zhes zhus so: gnyis pa gzugs dbyibs kha dog sogs la brtags pa ni/ yang ston pa'i zhal nas: kun byed kyi sogs/ zhes zhus pas: gsum ba byung gnas 'gro gsum sogs la brtags pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa: kye sems kyi rdo rje khyod sogs/ ces gsungs so: bzhi pa sems na pa bzhi'i rang bzhin rgyas par bshad pa ni/ stong chen mtha' yas na re: kye ston pa bcom ldan 'das nam mkha' ni sogs/ zhes gsungs so:nyis pa lam rig ngo sprad pa ni/ yang byang chub sems dpa' stong chen mtha' yas na re: bcom ldan 'das rnam par rtog pa sogs/ zhes gsungs so: gnyis pa rang gi ngo bo la lam byed pa/ gzhi gtan la dbab pa/ lam nyams sun pa/ shan 'byedakyi 'phyong bstan pa/ 'bras bu grol tshul dang bzhi las/ dngapo ma dag 'khor ba'i 'khrul tshul gtan la dbab pa dang / dag pa gzhi yi mtshan nyidatan la dbab pa dang gnyis las/ dang po la phyi'i gzung 'dzin gtan la dbab pa

bsdus te bstan pa dang gsum/ dang po la 'dzin pa gang zag gi bdag 'dzin bdag med du gtan la dbab pa dang / gzung ba chos kyi bdag 'dzin bdag med du gtan la dbab pa dang / de ltar gtan la dbab nas gzhi rang thog tu 'gags bsdams pa gsum las/ dang po gang zag gi bdag 'dzin gtan la dbab pa ni/ yang byang chub sems dpa' gsal khyab dbang po na re: kyi ston pa bcom ldan 'das khyab bdag mi g.yo ba'i sogs/ zhes gsungs so: gnyis pa gzung ba chos kyi bdag 'dzin bdag med du gtan la dbab pa la bzhi las/ ming gi gdags gzhi btsal ba/ dngos po'i rtag 'dzin bshig pa/ phan gnod kyi mtshangs la rgol ba/re dogs kyi rdzun phug rdib pa dang bzhi las/ dang po ming gi gdags gzhi btsal ba ni/yang gsal khyab dbang pos na re: ston pa bcom ldan 'das phyi yul gyi sogs/ ces gsungs so: gnyis pa dngos po'irtag 'dzin bshig pa ni/yang byang chub sems dpa' gsal khyab dbang po na re: kyi ston pa bcom ldan 'das gdul bya blo rmongs shing sogs/ zhes gsungs so:gsum pa phan gcod kyi mtshang la rgol ba ni/ yang snang ba'i dbang pos: kye ston pa bcom ldan 'das chos dbyings nam mkha' rnam dag gi sogs/ zhes gsungs so: bzhi pa re dogs kyi rdzun phug gting pa ni/ yang snang ba'i dbang pos na re:kyi ston pa bcom ldan 'das 'khor 'das thams cad sogs/bzla bar bya'o: gsum pa de ltar gtan la phab nas gzhi rang thog tu 'gags bsdam pa ne/ da ni chos nyid bde gshegs snying po nyid chos can sogs/ zhesagasungs so: gnyis pa nang dang gsang ba'i gzung 'dzinal 'khor 'das gyes mdo yin te/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i bzhugs tshul dang / 'khoraba'i 'khrul tshul gnyis las/ dang po gzhi'i bzhugs tshul ni/ yang snang ba'i dbang3

zhes bya'o: gnyis pa 'khor ba'i 'khrul tshul la/ nang gi gzung 'dzin dang /gsang ba'i gzung 'dzin gnyis las/ dang po nang gi gzung 'dzin ni/ de'i ngang ma rig pa ni 'khrul ba'i sogs/ lta bu yin no: gnyis pa gsang ba'i gzung 'dzin ni/ de ltar 'khrul ba'i snang ba la sogs/ grags pa yin no:gsum pa de dag mdor bsdus te bstan pa dang / bka' srung dregs pa dmigs gnad kyi mchod bsgrub byed pa dang gnyis las/ dang po phyi nang gsang gsum gyi gzung 'dzin mdor bsdus te bstan pa ni/ lar phyi ltar na ngar 'dzin la 'dzin par sogs/log na med do: gnyis pa bka' srung dregs pa dmigs gnad kyi mchod pa la dregs pa'i skye rgyud bshad pa dang / mchod gsol byed tshul gnyis las/ dang po dregs pa'i skye rgyud bshad pa ni/ khams gsum gyi gzhi lung ma bstan sogs/byung ba yin no: gnyis pa mchod gsol byed tshul la/ phyi yi mchod rdzas sgru ma lta bur dmigs te phul ba dang / nang gi mchod rdzas zab mo bdud gcod kyi sgo nas lus 'dod yon du spel ba gnyis las/ dang po phyi yi mchod rdzas sgyu ma lta bur dmigs te phulab ni/ de ltar lha bsgom pa'i nus mthu sogs/ zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa nang gi mchod rdzas zab mo bdud gcod0 sgo nas lus 'dod yon du spel ba ni/yang snang ba'i dbang pos na re: kyee ston pa bcom ldan 'das bdud gcod sogs/ zhes gsungs so/ / gnyis pa dag pa gzhi'i mtshan nyid bstan pa la/gzhi'i mtshan nyid dngos bshad pa dang / thabs dang shes rab kyi rgyas mdo bstan pa dang / ming gi 'jug tshul bshad pa gsum las/ dang po la gzhi bzang ngan gyi bsgyur du mi btub pa/ spros pa'i mtha' brgyad dang bral ba/ rnam par bar pa'i sgo gsum dang ldan pa/ sku lnga sogs kyi yon tan ldan tshul dang bzhi las/ dang po gzhi bzang ngan gyis bsgrur du mi btub pa ni/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' rig pa'i rdo rje stan 4

'das lags so: nga yi rang bzhin sogs/ phyir ro: gnyis pa spros pa'imatha' brgyad dang bral ba ni/ gzhi nyid las ma 'khrul ba 'dzin shes kyis sogs/ 'go 'khor ba'o: gsum pa rnam par thar ba'i sgo gsum dang ldan pa ni/ ka dag gdod ma'i mgon po sogs/ drang don yin no:bzhipa sku lnga sogs/ lnga tshan lnga yi yon tan bshad pa la/ lnga tshan dang po sku lnga ni/dang po sku lnga zhes bya bar sogs/ zhesabya ba yin no: gnyis pa ye shes lnga dang rigs lnga'i sangasatwas 'byung ba ni/ yang lha thams cad grub pa dang byung pa'i gzhi sogs/ shes par bya'o: gsum pa zhing khams lnga ni/ da ni yul la mngon par sogs/ drang don no: bzhi parigs lnga ni/ de dag rigs rus su bcad pa sogs/ bstan pa yin no/ lnga pa yum lnga ni/stong nyid nam mkha'i rdo rje sogs/ zhes gsungs so: gnyis pa thabs shes rgyas mdo ni/ thabs bskyed pa'i rim pa dang / shes rab rdzogs pa'i rim pa gnyis las/dang po bskyed rim la/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhirjes dang gsum las/ dang po sngon 'gro ni/yang byang chub sems dpa' rig pa'i rdo rjes 'di skad ces zhus so: kyi ston pa bcom ldan 'das chos sku mtshan ma med pa ni sogs/ shes par bya'o/gnyis pa bskyed rim dngos gzhi bsgom pa la/ da ni dngos gzhi'i rten zhing khams sogs/ rdzogs pa de ga'o: gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba la/ khams gsum gyi snod bcud 'dod yon thams cad sogs/ ma mchis pa'o/gnyis pa dmigs bcas rdzogs rim ni/ rlung no bsal ba/ bum can bsgom pa/gtum mo 'bar 'dzags bsgom pa/ rlung gi bcud len dang bzhi las/ dang po drung ro bsalab ni/ gzhan yang ma dag pa'i sgo gsum sogs/ shes par bya'o:

nyam bzhag gi rlung bsgom pa ni/ de nas mnyam bzhag gi rlung dang sogs/'gyur ro: gnyis pa rjes thob kyi rlung bsgom pa ne/ rjes thob yang don dam par sogs/ zungs shig: gsum pa gtum mo 'bar 'dzag bsgom pa ni/don dam par ji lta ba sogs/ 'bar bar 'gyur bo: bzhi pa 'byung lnga'irlung bcud len pa ni/ 'ga' zhig 'di la sogs/ bsdam pa yin:gsum pa ming gi 'jug tshul bshad pa la/ ming gi 'jug pa dngos dang / gzhi'i rang bzhinartags mardogs kyi dbang gis bde sdug myong ba la rdo rje'i gad mo spro ba dang gnyis las/ dang po ming gi 'jug pa dngos la bcu gnyis las/ dang po don dam byang chubakyi sems ni/ ming ji ltar 'jug na 'khor 'das sogs/ sems bya'o: gnyis pa gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa ni/ bka' gsang ba bas kyang sogs/ theg pa zhes bya'o/ gsum pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/bdag rtog 'khrul pa'i sogs/ zhes bya ba'o: bzhi pa 'od gsal rdo rje snyingapo ni/ sems can gyi sems rang bzhin gyi sogs/ snying po zhes bya'o: lnga pa 'khor 'das khub chub ni/ ma dag khams gsum sogs/ bya ba'o: drug pa gzhon nu bum sku ni/ skye ba'i mtha' ru sogs/ sku zhes bya'o: bdun pa thig le nyag gcig ni/ chos sku gzhir gnas kyi sogs/ces bya'o: brgyad pa klong gsal rdo rje snying po ni/ 'khor 'das yongs kyi chos nyid sogs/ zhes bya'o: dgu pa dbu ma dang phyag rgya chen po ni/phyogs gang du ma nges sogs/ rtogs pa yin no: bcu pa rdzogs pa chen po ni/ gzhi lung ma bstan du sogs/ shes par mdzod: bcu gcig pa shes rab bdun ni/ kyai rig pa'i rdo rje chos sku sogs/ bstan pa'o:

gsungs so: gnyis pa gzhi'i rang bzhin rtogs ma rtogs kyi dbang gis bdesdug myong ba la rdo rje'i gad mo bro ba ni/ yang byang chub sems dpa' rig pa'i rdorjes: kye ston pa bcom ldan 'das khams gsum gyi sogs/ 'gyuraba'o: spyi don gnyis pa lam bsgom pa'i tshul la bsgom tshul dang / lta sgom spyodagasum gyi gnad bstan pa/ rgyu 'bras las 'das pa'i lta ba rtogs na dge sdig phanaganod dang bral ba'i gtan tshigs/ lam sgom pa'i don mngon du gyur par smon lamabatab pa dang bzhi las/ dang po lam sgom tshul la/ yang byang chub sems dpa'arig pa'i rdo rjes: kye ston pa bcom ldan 'das khyab bdag mi g.yo ba'i sogs/ nyidayin no: gnyis pa lta sgom spyod gsum gyi gnad bstan pani/ da ni dngos gzhi nyams su len pa 'khor 'das sogs/ zhesagasungs pa la: gsum pa rgyu 'bras las 'das pa'i lta ba rtogs na dge sdig phanaganod dang bral ba'i gtan migs ni/ yang byang chub sems dpa' rig pa'i rdorjes: kye ston pa bcom ldan 'das 'di ltar rig pa'i sogs/ zhes gsungs so: bzhi pa lam sgom pa'i don mngon du gyur par smon lam btab pa nide nas byang chub sems dpa' rig pa'i rdo rje la sogs pa'i sogs/zhes gsungs so: gsum pa shan 'byed kyi 'phyong bstan pa dgu las/ dang po gol shor nor gsum gyi 'brang bsal ba ni/ yang byang chub sems dpa' rig pa'i rdo rjes: skyu ston pa bcom ldan 'das theg mchog bla na sogs/ shes par gyis sheg: gnyis pa sems dang rig pa gnyis kyi dbye ba ni/ sems dang rig pa gnyis kyi sogs/ zungasashig: gsum pa yid dang shes rabarkya dbye ba ni/ yid dang shes rab kyi dbye ba sogs/ dad pa'o: bzhi pa

pa'o: lnga pa kun gzhi dang chos sku'i dbye ba ni/ kyai rig pa'i rdo rje kun gzhi sogs/ yinano: drug pa lam yin pa dang ma yin pa'i dbye ba ni/ kyai rig pa'i rdo rje lam yin pa dang sogs/ ma yin no: bdun pa gzhi la bang bsgyur ba dang lung ma bstan gnyis kyi dbye ba ni/ kyai rig pa'i rdo rje gzhi dbang du sogs/ mi'agyur ro: brgyad pa 'khrul ba dang grokhi ba gnyis kyidabye ba ni/ kyai rig pa'i rdo rje 'khrul ba dang sogs/ zungs sheg:dgu pa sangs rgyas dang sems can gyi dbye ba ne/ kyai rig pa'i rdo rje sangs rgyas dang sogs/ 'khrul ba yin no: spyi don bzhi pa mthar thug 'bras bu'i grol tshul bstan pa ni/ da ni rtse gcig tu brtson 'grus sogs/ 'gyur ba yin no:de yan chadaspyi gzhi khregs chod song nas/ gnyis pa lam thod rgal bsgom pa la/ blo bcos pa dang / dngos gnyis las/ dang po blo bcos pa ni/ da ni tshe gcig lus gcig sogs/ bsten par bya'o: gnyis pa thod rgal dngos la/ brtson 'grus can dbang po rab rnams che 'dir grol ba'i gdams pa thod rgal bsgom pa dang dbang po 'bring dang tha ma rnams kyi bar do drug gi bsgom tshul gnyis las/ dang polan 'gro dang dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ dang po la phyi nang gsang gsum las/ dngapo phyi'i ru shan dbye ba ni/ da 'od gsal thod rgal sogs/ zhes bya ba'o:gnyis pa sgo gsum nang ltar ru shan dbye ba ni/ de nas sgo gsum nang ltar sogs/ bar 'gyur ro: gsum pa sgo gsum gsang ba ltar ru shan dbyeb ni/ de rdzogs pa'i rjes su gsang ba ltar sogs/ lag len no:nyis pa dngos gzhi bzhugs stangs gzigs stangs sgron drug rnams bstan pa ni/ da dngos gzhi nyams su len pa'i rim par sogs/ bzung bar bya'o:8

snangab ni/ de ltar nyams su blang na khregs chod sogs/ snang ba yin no: gnyis pa nyams gong 'phel ni/ nyams snang gong du 'phel tshul sogs/ thob pa yin no: gsum pa rig pa tshad phebs ni/ de nas rig pa bcud du smin pa sogs/ shes par gyis sheg: bzhi pa chos nyid zadapa'i snang ba ni/ kyi rig pa'i rdo rje de ltar nyams su sogs/ mngon par bstod: gnyis pa dbang po 'bring dang tha ma rnams kyi bar do drug bsgom tshul gyi dbye ba rang gzhung du gsal/ yang rig pa'i rdo rje la sogs pa'i sogs/mngon par bstod do: don gsum pa tha mar dge ba mjug gi don la gsum/ston 'khor rnams mdzad pa mthar phyin nas chos kyi dbyings su 'byams klas tshul/bka' rtsis phyag rgyas btab tshul/ gter 'don pa'i skyes bu dang gsum/ dang po ni/de ma thag tu ston pa mtsho skyes rdo rje sogs/ yin no: gnyis pa bka':sa kyi phyag rgyas btab tshul ni/ hūm̐ hūṃ rgyu: khams gsum gyi dbang phyug sogs/ gsum pa gter 'don pa'i skyes bu dam pa nyid bstan pa ne/ ces pa 'di ni mi lo sogs/ dza yantu:ces pa 'di yang bdud 'joms rdo rjes sbyar ba'o/ /

dag snang ye shes drwa ba las:gams lags rang byang si rgyang rngo rje'i sing po ba'ags so0 0/ / norab / sngar /sngar / / rtan rasmi3 / the5 (5gsasnyagasagis khyab bdag gdod ma'i ye gzhi kun tu bzang po'i rang zhal mngon du gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo: dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings su ro gcig pas rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa: bslab pa dang sbyangs pa'i rim pa la ma ltos par chos nyid nam mkha' mdzod kyi brda rang grol bas rig 'dzin brda yi brgyud pa: ye shes sgyu 'phrul rol pa'i snang cha las mi min rang snang gi ston pas bum pa gang bshos kyi tshul du gdul bya'i lam gyi 'jug sgo snyan brgyud du rang shar bas gang zagasnyan khung du brgyud pa: rnam gsum gcig tu dril ba'i bdag nyid chen po'agro ba'i bla mar chas pa la rtsa gsum dam can rgya mtshos gnang ba stsal dugasol: gdod ma'i gnas lugs ka dag spros pa dang bral ba'i chos nyid blo das chen po cibadag rtog gnyis 'dzin gyi sgrib pas bsgribs shing khamasasum 'khrul ba'i 'khor lor bden zhen gyis 'ching ba'i gang zag tu gyurayang : bskal ba mang por las dang bsod nams rgya cher bsags shing smonam rnam par dag pa'i stobs dang ldan te rang byung gi ye shes chen po la byaramed kyi bya ba byas pas las 'phro dang ldan zhing chos nyid nam mkha' mdzod la

dbang ba'i skal ba dang ldan pa rnams kyi spyod yul du: rgyud kyi rgyal po gzhi rgyud bde gshegs snying po'i gnas lugs rang byung gi rgyud de bkod par bya ste: rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i gsang gsum mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i byin gyis brlab cing mthar phyin par mdzad du gsol: theg mchog rgyal po rgyud chen 'di yi byung ba'i tshul bshad pa ni: chu pho khyi'i lo hor zla dang po'i chos bco lnga la bab pa'i nub mo thod rgal myur lam zab mo'i stobs kyis chos nyid mngon sum gyi snang ba shar ba dang : bskyed rim thabs kyi lam la cung zad sbyangs pa'i stobs kyis rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin gyi sa la slebs pa'i stobs dbang gis bdag gi snang sems thams cad chos nyid ka dag sbos pa dang bral ba'i dbyings su 'byams klas nas chos sku'i rang zhal mngon du gyur te: re zhig gi tshe lhun grub kyi snang ba zhing khams kyi bkod pa ru mched pa ni 'di lta ste: rang byung ka dag bde ba chen po'i dus de nyid du: gnas rang snang don gyi 'og min sgyu 'phrul rol pa'i zhing khams rgya che la khyon yangs pa ngos 'jam zhing khod snyoms pa: sman gyi spangs ri la dri bzang gi na bun 'thul ba: kha dog dkar po dang ser po dang dmar po dang ljang gu dang mthing ga dang sngon po dang khra bo bkrag mdangs 'od du 'bar ba gsal la tsher zhing snum la mdzes pa yid du 'ong ba'i me tog padma sna tshogs pas sa gzhi thams cad yongs su khebs pa: mnan na rnam zhing btegs na spar ba gas bzhi ru yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po bzhi da pa: rgya mtsho chen po de dag gi 'gram na rin po che'i gram pa dang :ser gyi bye ma dang : g.yu yi ne'u seng dang : 'ja' yi 'od khyim 'khrigs : mtshams bzhi na dag byed bdud rtsi'i chu mig dang : dpag ba/sda gyi

ljon shing gi nags tshal rgyas pa: sngon shing las 'dod yon gyi sprin dpung sna tshogs 'phro ba: sprul pa'i bya rigs sna tshogs kyis mdzes pa'i gzugs ngoms shing snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis chos sgra sgrogs pa: sprul pa'i srog chags rnam pa sna tshogs kyis rtsed 'jo rol zhing mdzes pa'i rnam 'gyur ngoms bzhin chos nyan pa'i tshul ston pa: nam mkha' thams cad la 'ja' tshon 'od kyi drwa ba mig mang ris su bris pa: bar snang gi 'khor yug kun tu dpa' bo dang dpa' mos bro gar 'khyugs shing: lha mo mang pos 'dod yon spel zhing bkur ste byed pa'i gnas de nyid kyi dbus su mngon par dga' ba'i skyed mo'i tshal chen po na: seng ge brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri rgya che la dpang mtho brtsi ljon shing lo 'dab me tog rgyas pa la log gtad pa: thon pa'i yal ga la dar sna tshogs pa'i dbyangs pa 'phyang ba: rin po che'i phreng ba'i drwa ba dang drwa phyed dril g.yer sil snyan mang pos dam pa'i chos kyi sgra rang byung du grags pa: seng khri de'i khar padma dang nyi ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du gzhi'i rang gdangs rang snang don gyi ston pa kun bzang mtsho skyes rdo rje sku mdog mthing nag gzhon nu lo brgyad lon pa'i rnam pa can: phyag g.yas pas chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad cing g.yon pas mnyam bzhag mdzad pa:mtshan dang dpe byad kyis mdzes shing longs spyod rjogs pa'i chas thams cad kyis brgyan pa: sku dwangs gsal rgya mtsho lta bu'i dbyings su zhi khro rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i zhing dang bkod pa thams cad mtsho la gza' skar gyi gzugs brnyan bkra ba ltar rang shar ba 'od dang 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro zhing 'bar ba'i rtse nas brda yig sna tshogs 'char ba: ston pa de la rang rtsal sgyu 'phrularol pa'i 'khor byang chub sems dpa' rig pa'i rdo rje dang / byang chub sems

byang chub sems dpa' stong chen mtha' yas dang : byang chub sems dpa'agasal khyab dbang po dang : byang chub sems dpa' bkod pa lhun grub dang :byang chub sems dpa' gzhan snang dbang byed dang : byang chub sems dpa' mig gi dbang po dang : byang chub sems dpa' rna ba'i dbang po dang ca byang chub sems dpa' sna yi dbang po dang : byang chub sems dpa' lce yi dbang po dang : byang chub sems dpa' lus kyi dbang po la sogs pa'i 'dus pa brgyad khri bzhi stong gi tshogs thams cad gnas de nyid du 'dus par gyur te 'dug go: de thams cad kyis ston pa nyid kyi zhal la lta zhing gusashing 'dud pas cang mi smra bar 'dug: ston pa nyid kyang spyan nam mkha'i dbyings su gzigs nas cang mi gsungs par bzhugs so: slar yang nam mkha' rnam par dag pa'i dbyings nas chos nyid kyi rang sgra 'di byung ngo :ā: 'khor 'das thams cad gzhi rtsa bral: rdo rje btsun mo nam mkha' che: stong chen nam mkha' yum chen mo: chos rnams thams cad chos nyid ngang : bdag nyid gcig pu'i cho 'phrul las: skye ba med las thams cad skyes: skye ba'i cho 'phrul 'byung 'gyur 'gags: rgyu rkyen rang mal gsod pa'i phyir: ston dang bstan pa lam 'bras bu: chos nyid mtshan ma tshig bral las: thabs dang shes rab du ma'i sgo: rang byung rang shar chen por snang : yul med zang thal chen po'i mkha': dwangs gsal rnyog ma bral ba las: zhing dang ston 'khor bkod pa kun: med bzhin med la yod snang ba: ngo mtshar chen por mngon par bstod: ces sgra de byung ma thag tu khor 'dus pa thams cad kyis bcom ldan 'das la mgrin gcig tu 'di 13

rgyal po gsan cing dgongs su gsol: 'dir zhing dang ston pa 'khor 'dus pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad ci'i phyir ci las byung ba'i tshul ston pa nyid kyis bstan du gsol: zhes zhus so: ston pa nyid kyis bka' stsal pa: kyi sgyu 'phrul rol pa'i 'khor rnams nyon cig: 'dir ye shes sgyu 'phrul rol pa'i zhing dang ston 'khor ci'i phyir byung zhe na: khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i sems can thams cad kyi dbang skal du dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs rgyud rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes la 'jug pa'i sgo ston pa'i phyir: rang snang don gyi 'og min zhing khams kyi bkod pa ru snang ba ni shes rab dang ye shes kyi stobs shugs chen pos chos nyid kyi mthong chen po phyes pa'o: nga ni ye gzhi bde gshegs snying po'i rang gdangs las rang snang gi ston pa rang la snang ba dang : rig stong spros pa dang bral pa'i rang gdangs rig pa'i rdo rje dang / bdag med shes rab kyi rang gdangs shes rab dbang po dang : rnam par shes pa tshogs brgyad sems byung dang bcas pa'i rang gdangs 'dus pa'i 'khor gyi tshogs su snang ba'o: zhes gsungs so: de nas byang chub sems dpa' shes rab dbang po stan las langs te bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces: ston pa bcom ldan 'das nyid bde gshegs snying po'i rang gdangs su shar ba dang :bdag shes rab kyi dbang po shes rab kyi rang gdangs dang : rig pa'i rdo rje rig pa'i rang gdangs las snang ba dang : rnam shes tshogs brgyad sems byung dang bcas pa las byang chub sems dpa' dang sems ma'i tshogs su snang ba na na khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad la de ltar snang dgos pa las 14

'khrul ba bde sdug dgra gnyen gyi snang ba mched nas khams gsum du kha brgyud de sdug bsngal ba las: dag pa'i snang ba mi 'byung bas de ci'i phyir lags ston pa nyid kyis bstan du gsol: zhes zhus pas: yang bka' stsal pa:kyai rigs kyi bu gzhi lung ma bstan du song bas sems can rnams kyis dag pa'i snang ba mthong ba ma yin te: ma dag 'khrul ba'i sems snang dgra gnyen bdesdug tu snang ba sems can rang ka ma dag gi mtshan nyid yin te: 'dir dgapa'i snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa mched pa ni sngon mi min rang snang gi ston pardzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang : o rgyan mtsho skyes rdo rje'i zhal sngar 'khod cingardo rje theg pa'i chos kyi sgor zhugs te sgrub pa lhur len byas pas mchog gidangos grub thob nas 'gro khams rgya mtsho ma stong gi bar du smon lam rnam paradag pa'i stobs bskyed pas yang yang 'gro ba'i don du gdul bya rang rgyud dngamathun pa'i ston par bzhengs te sngon gyi las 'phro sad nas chos nyid kyi bdenapa mngon sum du gzigs shing shes rab klong nas rdol ba'i skyes bu rnams lashes rab ye shes kyi stobs dang shugs kyis dag pa'i snang ba shar yang semasadang sems byung rang ma yin te: ngo bo mngon gyur gyi dbyings las rtsal dusnang ba ni sems can gyi sems tshogs brgyad rang min zhing de las mi gzhanapa'i phyir de la de'i ming gdags pa'o: ston 'khor gnyis su med pa lasasnang ba'i sgo du ma ru snang ba yin te: byang chub sems dpa' zhes su gragasapa yang : sangs ma rgyas kyang srid pa las rab tu 'phags pa la: de ltar grags pa yin: zhes gsungs so: yang byang chub sems dpa' shes rababang pos: kyi ston pa bcom ldan 'das legs so: de ltar sgyu 'phrulal pa'i ston 'khor thams cad gnyis su med cing tha mi dad pas na: ston

dang 'khor tshogs 'chad nyan thams cad la dgos pa med cing : thams cad kyi ye shes yon tan la khyad par ma mchis pas 'dir 'chad nyan gyi tshul na pa la dgos pa ci zhig yod ston pa nyid kyis bstan du gsol: zhes zhus : yang bka' stsal pa: kyi shes rab dbang po sngon 'das pa'i dus su dul bya rang snang gi ston pa shākya thub pa zhes bya ba: nyi ma lta bu'i ston pa da kyis: nyi zer dang nyi 'od lta bu'i sprul pa shar te ston pa dang : zhu ba po dang : 'khor nyan pa po'i tshul du gdul bya 'dul ba'i lam theg pa'i rnam grangs so sor 'chad nyan gyi rnam par snang ba ni: ston 'khor gnyis su med kyang gdul bya'i ched du thabs kyis rnam 'gyur sna tshogs pa sgyu ma mkhan dang sgyu 'phrul lta bur bstan pa yin no: zhes gsungs so: de nas byang chub sems dpa' stong chen mtha' yas pas bcom ldan 'das la gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing thal mo sbyar te 'di skad do: kyi ston pa bcom ldan 'das bdag cag rnams la sems can thams cad srid pa sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral nas rnam par grol ba'i sa la sbyor ba'i phyir tshe gcig lus gcig nyid du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang po'i go 'phang mngon du 'thob par byed pa'i gdams pa zab mo bstan du gsol: zhes zhus so: ston panyid kyis bka' stsal pa: mya stong chen mtha' yas pa la sogs pa'i 'khor 'dus pa'i tshogs thams cad nyon cig: sems can thams cad rnam paragrol ba'i sa lam la sbyor pa'i lam gyi lam ma chog dam pa myur lam 'od gsalardzogs pa chen po zhes bya ba chos thams cad kyi dam pa: lam thams cad kyispyi chings: theg pa thams cad kyi rol pa: gsang sngags thams cad kyi klong1 /dzod zab mo zhig yod kyang: de ni bskal ba dpag tu med pa la bsod

nams kyi sgo du ma nas tshogs rgya chen po bsags shing ca yang nas yang du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis go 'phang la smon lam rgya chen po btab pa dang :sngon yang theg pa gzhan nas lam nges par rnyed pa'i phyir: lam btsal nas lam la bag chags bzhag pa'i skyes bu ma gtogs pa lam 'di dang 'phrad par mi 'gyur ro: ci'i phyir zhe na: las ngan pa'i dbang dang nyon mongs pa'i bsru bdud stobs che ba'i shugs kyis theg pa 'di 'chad nyan gyi khrod na yod kyang skal med rnams kyi blo yid chos 'di las dpag tshad lnga brgya'i pha mthar 'brog dgon pa ru gnas pa dang : skal med smon lam log pa'i bdud 'bangs rnams kyis gshe ba dang : sgro btags dang : skur 'debs phrag dog pa sogs zab chos 'di la 'gal zla bsgrub par 'gyur ba las 'di'i sgor 'jug cing don nyams su len pa ni nyin mo'i skar ma tsam las yod mi srid de:la las ni sgo 'di ru zhugs nas go tsam shes tsam thos tsam gyi thog tu bzhag nas bag med par kha 'khyol te nyams su ma lon par 'chi kha tha mal du lus nas grol ba mi thob ste: spyir theg pa 'di'i sgor 'jug cing nyams su len pa la mtshan nyid 'di dag tshang dgos te: chos dang bla ma la yid ches pa dang :lam la the tshom med cing blo gtod pa: 'chi ba snying nas dran cing 'dus byas rtag pa'i rang bzhin du thag chod nas 'khor ba'i bya ba la chags zhen chung ba: zas nor longs spyod la chog shes yod pa: brtson 'grus dang snying stobs chen pos chos la chog mi shes pa dang : sdug yus med pas rtag tu tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam par byed pa: lo zla'i mtshams sgrub tsam la byas/ yus med par blo dang rgyud brtan pa rnams kyis sgo 'di mthong nas nyams su blangs na tshe cig lus gcig 'di nyid la rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gis mchog nges pa/ /ba

par gdon mi za ba yin: theg pa gzhan rnams la bskal ba grangs med gsum la tshogs bsags shing sgrib pa sbyangs nas mthar mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par gsungs yang : bskal pa du mar las nyon bag chags kyi dbang gis skye ba mang por kha brgyud tshe bsam spyod las kyi sna kha rkyen gyis bsgyur nas tshogs bsags sgrib sbyang gi lam dang 'phrad dka' ba'i tshul:bsam mno zhib tu thong dang gsal nges pa can de yin mod: deng dus sngon gyi las 'brel bzang po'i stobs kyis mi lus dam pa dal 'byor thob pa dang :chos kyi dam pa gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i chos dang 'phrad dus 'dir yun rang po la las bsags nas mthar sangs rgyas pa la re ba don dam pa ru mi 'dzin par tshe lus 'dir grol ba'i lam ye gzhi bde gshegs snying po'i rang ngo mngon du gyur te rang thog tu rang sa zin pa zhig byed dgos pa don dam payin: de ma rgetogs skye ba gzhan nas gzhan du kha brgyud de las mang pobasags pa'i 'bras bus rnam par grol ba'i sa 'thob rgyu yod par bstan pa rnams ni sems can gyi rgyud la gnas skabs kyi bde 'bras 'jog pa tsam lasasangs rgyas pa ni shin tu dka' ste drang don tsam du zad pa la ltos sheg:ces gsungs pa la: byang chub sems dpa' stong chen mtha' yas pas 'diskad du: kyi ston pa bcom ldan 'das da ris mi tshe 'di ru sems rgya bskyed pa'i bsam bzang dang : lus ngag gis dge ba la 'bad pa las gsang sngags rdo rje snying po 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i lta sgom ni ma 'ongs pa'idus shig tu nyams su blangs te grol ba thob par 'gyur srid de: da lta'i dusa'adir nyams su blangs pas grol ba thob par dka' bar 'chad pa dang :nyan rang dang sems can blo chung rnams kyis rdo rje theg pa'i chos zab cing rgya18

sems can gyi sems la bzang ngan dang che chung yod srid de theg pa chen po'i rigs can du bsgyur dgos na: chung ba che ru 'gro ba'i skye ba dang: che ba bskyed du med pa'i yangs ba rnams mchis na rang gi rgyud la mi gnas pa'i gsang sngags (zhig)gzhan ngos nas 'byung 'gyur du song ba'i 'di'i don mi shes te ston pa nyid kyis bstan du gsol: zhes zhus so: yang bka' stsalapa: kyi stong chen mtha' yas khyod de ltar sems na dus da lta'i tshe 'di la gsang sngags kyi sgo dang 'phrad de: de la yid ches kyi dad pa brtan po zhig dang : thang lhod med pa'i brtson 'grus drag po zhig yod na: nyams su len pa'i dus skal la babs pa yin pa las: skye ba gzhan du 'phros pa'i tshe yangagal srid las skal dang ldan pa'i skyes bu gsang sngags zab mo'i sgo dang 'phrad nas yid ches pa'i dad pa brtan po thob pa tsam las gsang sngags nyams su len pa'i dus la babs pa red snyam pa'i mngon shes dang rtags dngarten 'brel 'byung rgyu nam yang med nges pa can yin: mi lus thob nasagasang sngags kyi chos dang bla mar 'phrad tshe rdzogs pa chen po nyams su len pa'idus ma yin zhe na rten 'brel de tsam las skye ba gzhan du yang 'byung rgyu med ngesapa can yin no: nyan rang dang so skyes la sogs pa blo chung ba yang ma yin te: sngon las kyi dbang gis gsang sngags kyi sgo dang mi 'phrad pa dang :'phrad kyang mi dad pa dang : yid mi ches pa dang : le lo dang rnam par g.yeng ba'i dbang gis nyams su mi long ba las sems che chung gi bye brag ma na pa'i ngang tshul shes par gyis shig: sems can thams cad kyi sems la chung yod par ma sems shig: sems can bdag 'dod kyis bcings pa 1

mas la rang mi dmigs par nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad la sems rgya cher bskyed na de'i 'bras bu bdag gzhan gnyis su med pa'i na mthong ba la rloms pa yin par la bzla'o: zhes gsungs so: yang nga chen mtha' yas pas: kyi ston pa bcom ldan 'das zab gsang rdzogs chen po bsgom pa'i blo rgya bskyed mi nus pa yin nam: rdzogs pa chen po sgom yang byang chub kyi sems logs nas bskyed dgos pa yin nam: ston pa nyid kyis bstan du gsol: zhes zhus pas: bka' stsal pa: kye gas kyi bu rdzogs pa chen po 'di ni 'bras bu bla na med pa'i theg pa yin te:khor 'das yongs khyab kyi khyab bdag chen po de nyid mngon du byed pa don dam pa gzhi'i byang chub sems nyid yin te de nyid du rang sa bzung ba las:zhan bya rtsol blo yid kyis bzo bcos byed pa'i byang chub sems bskyed ces bya ba de yang bskyed pa po bdag dang yul gzhan la dmigs pa'i blo phur khung lta ba yin no: rdzogs pa chen po'i dbyings na gdod nas 'khor 'das dag mnyam chen po'i rang bzhin yin pa'i ngang tshul kun mkhyen ye shes chen pos zhi nyid kyi gnas lugs ji lta ba bzhin du mkhyen cing kun gzigs ye shes na pos gzigs pa las lhag pa'i sems bskyed pa yod par 'chad na chu rang yod kyang rlan gzhan nas 'tshol dgos zer pa dang 'dra mtshungs nges pa na no: byang chub kyi sems zhes bya ba ni gdod ma'i ye gzhi ka dag 'khor das yongs khyab kyi bdag nyid chen po de nyid yin par ma shes na: pha ma'ibu la snying rje dang byams sems byas pa tsam gyis bsam bzang gcig pu ni rnamapar rtog pa dang : bsam pa dang : dmigs bcas yin te mtho ris kyibade ba don du gnyer ba tsam las sangs rgyas kyi sa la re ba ni mo gsham gyi bu20

sems dpa' stong chen mtha' yas pas 'di skad ces: kyi ston pa bcom ldan 'das gdul bya rnam par grol ba'i lam zab mo ston pa nyid kyis bstan du gsol: zhes zhus pas bka' stsal pa: kye rigs kyi bu thar ba chen po'i grong khyer du 'jug pa'i sgo thabs dang shes rab kyi sgo du mar snang yang cadon dam par sems la lam byas nas yang dag pa'i lam 'tshol ba dang :gzhi gtan la dbab nas chos nyid rang la lam byed pa dang : chos nyid kyi rang rtsal la lam byed pa'i sgo du mar snang yang : 'dir rang snang ye shes kyi rtsal dang : ngo bo la lam byed pa gnyis yod pa las: dang po sems kyi rtsal lam rnam pa la lam byed pa'i tshul ni: dad pa dam tshig dang ldan pa'i slob ma rnams la: dang po thun mong phyi'i sngon 'gro blo ldog rnam pa bzhi dang :thun mong ma yin pa nang gi sngon 'gro rnam pa bdun gyi sgo nas rgyud thul bar byas te: mthar dngos gzhi lam 'tshol ba'i rim pa la 'jug tshul ni:'di lta ste: dang po gnas rab tu dben pa'i tshal du phyin nas bla ma la gsol ba 'debs shing thugs yid bsres te yun cig bab kyis bzhag: kyi stong chen mtha' yas khyod kyi lus dang : ngag dang : yid gsum po la gtso gang gi che: byed po su yin: 'gyur ba med pa'i rang dbang rgyal po de gangayin kyang nga la smos sheg dang ca gdul bya'i don chen po ru 'chad nyan dang khrid tshul ji bzhin pa gsal bar 'gyur ro: zhes gsungs so: de nas byang chub sems dpa' stong chen mtha' yas pas: kyi ston pa bcom ldan das lus ni sems kyis bzos pa yin te: shi ba'i dbang du byas na'ang bem rig so sor 'byed tshe sems las kyi rjes su 'khrul te yang lus snang bzung

lus med pa'i dbang du byas na yang nyin mo'i lus dang : mi lam gyi lus dang : phyi ma'i lus rten thams cad sems bdag 'dzin gyis bzos te sems la snang ba tsam las yod ma myong par 'phral du gnas 'gyur byed pas:sems ni kun byed kyi rgyal po yin pas de gtso che: yang lus sems so sor 'byed pa'i dbang du byas kyang: sems med pa'i lus ro ru song bas de la nus stobs med pa dang : lus sems so sor gyes srid na bde sdug myong tshor dang : sangs rgyas kyi sa la sleb pa'am: khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams yang sems rnam par shes pa yul du 'khrul pas mkhan po de nges pa'o: ngag ni smra brjod kyi snang ba ji ltar shar yang sems la snang ba tsam las med: sems kyi rnam par rtog pas smra brjod kyi snang ba bzos pa tsam las ngag gzhan na ma grub pas gtso sems kyi che ba dang : lus ngag yid gsum so sor gyes pa'i dbang du byas kyang sems pha rol tu song : lus ro ru song : ngag yul med du yal ba de yin pas: gtso sems kyi che nges pa yin: sgo gsum tha dad du ma grub pa'i tshul ni bskyed rim gyi skabs su'ang sgo gsum yi dam lha'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum gyi rol pa ru sbyong ba'i der gnas su dag nas grol thob pa yin te: tha dad pa yin na sku mi 'gyur (ba'i)rdo rje dang gsung mi 'gags pa'i rdo rje gnyis shul du lus te thugs gzhan yul du dengs nas rdo rje gsum gyi tshogs pa gyes tshe lha shi ba min nam:'i phyir tha dad ma grub par du ma ro gcig tu thag chod par 'gyur lags so: ltar gsum ga sems las med de sems gcig pu ru thag chod pa ni mchogatu go ba bla na med pa yin no: zhes zhus so: yang ston pa'i zhal nas:kuX sprad kyi rgyal po khyod la gzugs mchis sam ma mchis: gal te mchis

mig dang : rna ba dang : sna dang : lce dang : yid rnams mchis sam ma mchis: gal te yod srid na deng sang de dag gang du mchis: gar gnas: mig gnyis phyi nang dang : rna ba dang : sna dang : lce rnams phyi nang rim par yod par 'dod dam: gal te de lta bu ma mchis na: khyod ladabyibs zlum po'am: gru bzhi: zla gam: gru gsum: zur mang lasogs pa mchis sam ma mchis: kha dog kyang dkar po: ser po:dmar po: lngang gu: sngon po mthing ga: khra bo rnams yod dam med:yod srid na mngon sum mig gis mthong ba dang : reg pa lag pas bzung steng la nges par ston cig: gal te cang med ye med nges pa zhig yin na nichad pa'i mthar lhung bas da lta 'khor 'das bde sdug snang sems nyer lenathams cad chos can: de don nga la smos shig: ces gsungs so: yangastong chen mtha' yas pas: kye ston pa bcom ldan 'das bdag la gzugasam mchis pas gzugs kyis stong : de bzhin du sgra dang dri dang ro dang regabya dang chos rnams ma mchis pas de yis stong: dbyibs dang kha dog gisastong ste stong pa'o: mig dang rna ba dang sna dang lce dang yid rnams thams cadas pa dwangs gsal nyid las ma grub par nges pa'o: med pa chad pa ru masong bar 'khor 'das kyi rnam 'gyur ma nges pa sgyu ma mkhan dang sgyu ma'i sprulab lta bur byed cing snang ba'i mkhan po go ma 'gags pa tsam du nges legs so:zhes zhus pas: bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa: kye sems kyi rdo rjed dang po byung ba'i khungs gang yin pa de nga la smos shig: sa las byungangam: chu dang me las byung ngam: rlung dang nam mkha' las byung ngam:23

mkhan la brtag cing dpyod cig: de bzhin du bar du gnas pa'i sa dang gnas mkhan la brtag cing dpyod cig: sems zhes bya ba 'di mgo bo la gnas na rkang pa la tsher mas btab pa lta bu la'ang na tsha zug rngu 'byung ba'i don ma mchis pa dang : rkang pa la gnas na mgo dang yan lag gzhan rnams bcad kyang na tsha sogs ci la byung : lus spyi la gnas na pha rol nas lus bcas dang kha phor gnas khang dang nor rdzas la sogs pa gzhan gyis khyer ba dang rkyen gyis 'jig pa la sogs pa ci byung yang sems la mi bzod pa'i 'gyod sems dang sdug bsngal 'byung na der gnas dgos pa dang : nang la gnas na nang las phyi la bdag tu 'dzin mkhan med pa dang : phyi (la)na gnas na nang gi lus la zhen 'dzin mi 'byung ba dang : deng sang gnas sa mchis na gnas sa dang bral ba'i tshe ci la gnas gang la brten: gnas mkhan gyi byad dang bzhin dang: gnas sa dang gnas mkhan mngon sum du ston cig:gnas sa gnas mkhan gyi yul dang bdag po'i che chung gi tshad la sogs pa lartogs shig: ltos shig: tha ma 'gro sa dang 'gro mkhan la brtag dgosapas sems kun byed kyi mkhan po 'gro ba'i yul dang lam dang sgo dang ji ltara'agro ba'i tshul rnams la ltos shig: gal te 'gro sa dang 'gro bdag mthong na: 'gro mkhan gyi ngo bo'i che chung dang gzugs dang dbyibs kha dog nga la ston cig: ces gsungs so: stong chen mtha' yas na re: kyi ston pabacom ldan 'das nga la mig med: mig ma mchis pa las gzugs su snang bam mchis: de bzhin du rna ba med: rna ba ma mchis pa las sgra ru snang ba mamachis: sna med: sna ma mchis pa las dri ru snang ba ma mchis: lce med:24

lco ma mchis pa las ro ru snang ba ma mchis: lus med: lus ma mchis pa las reg byar snang ba'ang ma mchis so: de ltar sgo lngar snang ba dang bcas pa med pas byung mkhan med do: byung mkhan grub na 'di dus phan chad dus 'di zhes bya bar sems zhes bya ba ma grub cing med: byung na byung tshun chad du yod pa 'di zhes ngos bzung mtshan ma can yod dgos pas: nga ni ma byung ba'i stong pa nyid yin pas byung ba'i khungs stong : byung sa btsal na: sa ning rang gis bzos pa yin: de bzhin du chu dang me dang rlung dang nam mkha' la sogs pa'i snang ba thams cad bdag 'dzin gcig pu'i cho 'phrul las gzhan gcig kyang ma mchis pas byung sa dang byung mkhan yul med du thag chod pa yin: nga ni mi gnas pas stong pa nyid yin te gnas pa'i sa med: lusazhes bya ba nyin mor snang ba'i lus la rma dang skrang dang lnga ba dang phol mig la sogs pa snang yang rmi lam gyi lus la de ma grub: mi lam gyi lus dang yanalag la rma dang skrang dang lba ba dang phol mig rdol ba snang yang nyin snang na mgrub: nyin snang la lus smas pa dang rgyal po'i chad pas gdung bar snang yang rmi lam gyi lus la de mi snang : mi lam na de ltar byung ba nyin snang gi lus la de ma grub: de bzhin du phyi ru snang ba dang nang du 'dzin pa'i gnas yul bdag po thams cad nga gcig pu'i cho 'phrul las med de: de'i phyir nga phyinang gi snang ba la mi gnas: phyi nang gi snang ba nga la mi gnas: bdag tu 'dzin pa'i cho 'phrul sgyu ma dang sgyu 'phrul lta bu ste: sgyu ma mkhan dang sgyu 'phrul lta bur bsam bzhin du bzos pa'ang ma yin te: bdag shar bas gzhan snang rang byung du shar ba tsam las gnas pa'i sa med pa'o: 'gro ba'i yul dang bdag po la brtag kyang 'gro sa 'gro yul thams cad yul med du song

sa med bzhin du snang: lus ngag yid dang gsum po yang ye nas so sor ma ba bzhin du ro gcig pa'i tshul: nyin snang dang rmi snang dang phyi ma'i snang ba thams cad nga las sgo gsum tha dad du ma grub pas 'gro ba'i bdag po dang gul ma grub pa ru thag chod pa yin no: zhes zhus so: bcom ldan 'das sa bka' stsal pa: kyi sems kyi rdo rje khyod kyi sems zhes bya ba'i che chung gi tshad la brtags nas ngo bo gtan la phob la ngos zungs shig: phyi'i nam mkha' dang nang gi sems gnyis ka gcig yin nam so sor tha dad yin:gcig yin na sems kyi ngo bo nam mkha' yin dgos pa dang : tha dad pa na na rmi lam gyi nam mkha' dang nyin snang gi nam mkha' dang : phyi ma'i nam mkha' rnams gcig ma yin par tha dad yin par 'chad dgos te:nam mkha' snga ma 'gags te phyi ma rnams rim pa bzhin du 'byung 'gyur yin na: nam mkha' thams cad 'phro 'gyur skye 'gags can du 'gyur ba'i de rgyu rkyen ci las byung ba'i kho thag chod par gyis shig: nyin mo nyi ma'i rkyen gyis nam mkha' la nam langs nas snang ba mngon du byed pa yin na: mi lam dngaphyi ma'i dus rnams su snang ba mngon du byed mkhan nyi ma yin nam: rangasems kyi 'od gsal yin thag kha tsam ma yin par gting dpog par chod cig: ces gsungs so: stong chen mtha' yas na re: kye ston pa bcomaldan 'das nam mkha' ni bdag gi sems kyi ngo bo nges par gdon mi za ba yin te: nyin snang du nam mkha'i klong du sa dang chu dang me dang rlung dang bdag dang gzhan dang : gzugs dang : sgra dang : dri dang ca ra dang reg bya dang 6 chos rnams rnam par mched de sems rnam par rtog pas 26

nye bar len pa dang : mi snang na'ang sems kyi gzhi nam mkha' ru snang nas de bzhin du snod bcud 'dod yon thams cad kyi snang ba sngar bzhin du yang mched pa dang : phyi ma yang sems kyi ngo bo nam mkha' ru snang ba'i klong dusnod bcud 'dod yon thams cad gong bzhin snang nas nye bar len zhing yanganas yang du 'khrul pa yin: nyin snang du nam mkha'i klong du sprin dang na bun sa zhig dang ri rnyil gyi snang ba mthong yang: mi snang na de ma grub par gzhan zhig snang ba dang : mi snang na'ang sprin dang na bun dri bzhon mun nag 'thib pa sogs rmis tshe sad pa tsam nas yang gzhan zhig snang ba de bzhin du phyi ma'i dus su yang nam mkha' yangs pa'i klong du snang sems bde sdug thams cadasnang ba yin: de'i phyir nam mkha' dang bdag gzhan 'dod yon thamasacad ro gcig cing tha mi dad pa yin par thag chod: snang ba mngon du byedamakhan yang nam mkha'i gsal cha nyid las gzhan ma yin te: sems kyi gzhidang ngo bo nam mkha' nyid yin te: de lta bu yid ye gnas kyi shes pa dwangs shing gsal ba'i dbyings su sna tshogs snang ba ni dper na me long dang : chu dwangs gsal gyi ngang du (nang du ) gzugs brnyan dang gza' skar mched pabazhin du snang ba mched pa yin: shes pa dwangs gsal dbu ma nam mkha' stong khyab kyi dbyings su zhugs nas kha nang lta ru song tshe snang sems thams cadami mngon par stong khyab lung ma bstan du 'byams klas pa yin te: sems kyi gzhi dbyings ngo bo stong khyab chen po bdag 'dzin gyis phyi nang du shar ba yin par thag chod pa yin: nam mkha' gzhan ma yin: gsal cha yang gzhan ma yin par sems nyid dwangs gsal gyi bdag nyid rkyen gyi dbang gis bdagagazhan du song ba yin: sems rang la lam byas nas dbang po rab kyiswā /sa

kyi lta ba rtogs te nam mkha' rnam par dag pa'i dbyings su grol ba thob pa dang : 'bring gzugs med khams su brtan pa thob pa dang : tha ma gzugs khams su bde ba nyams su myong ba dang : yang tha 'dod khams su dga' bde snang ba'i lam dang tshul ston pa nyid kyis bstan du gsol: zhes zhus pas: bka' stsal pa: kyi sems kyi rdo rje sems 'di dang po phyi'i nam mkha' la bsres te zhag bdun du mnyam par bzhag: yang rdo dang shing bu dang sku gzugs dang yi ge gang yang rung ba la sems bzung ste zhag bdun du mnyam par bzhag: yang rang gi snying gar 'od lnga'i thig le gsal 'tsher zhig bsgom nas de la sems bzung ste zhag bdun la mnyam par bzhag pas 'ga' zhig la sems bde kyi le: gsal sang nge: stong had de bar gnasashing rnam par rtog pa gang yang med par rgya mtsho rlabs kyis ma bskyod pa lta bur 'char ba ni mtshan ma can gyi zhi gnas zhes bya ba de yin: 'ga' zhig sems rnam par rtog pa ha cang rgod drag pas mi non pa dang : snying dngasrog rtsa la sogs pa la mi bde ba'i nad dang zug rngu 'byung ba dang : 'ga'azhig la brgyal ba rmug 'thib 'byung ba rnams ni blo rgyud mi brtan pa rlung khamasapa dang blo rtsing po rnams la ma nges par 'byung ba yin: de'i tshe rnam parartog pa rang khar lhod cing mi brjed pa'i dran pa dang : thog tu ma gyur pa'i shes bzhin gyis blta zhing bskyangs te: chung (ciyang )mi sems par gnas pa la ngo bo'i ngang du gnas pa zhes bya ba dang : rnam par rtog pa sna tshogs 'gyuzhing shar ba la 'gyu ba zhes bya ba dang : rnam par rtog pa gang shar lkog gyuradu ma song bar dran shes kyis rig pa la rig pa zhes: bshad nas ngo sprod de:2

da ngo bo'i ngang du gnas pa'i yun bsring pa'i ched du 'gyu ba la ltos la lus drang por bsrang dran pa mngon du zhog la ltos shig ces brjod de: de ltar nyams su blangs pa'i tshe na 'gyur rtog thams cad bkag pa yang ma yin:rang khar shor ba yang ma yin par dran rig gis mngon du byed pa yin: de la thun dang thun mtshams thams cad du bar ma chad par brtson pas mthararnam rtog phra rags thams cad ngo bo stong ba'i dbyings su zhi nas mi g.yo ba'i ngang la gnas shing brtan par 'gyur te bde ba mee drod lta bu dang : gsal snang nam langs pa lta bu dang : mi rtog pa rgya mtsho rlabs kyis ma bskyod pa lta bu myong zhen can yid la 'bral mi phod pa yid ches shing mngon zhen bslang bar byed pa zhig 'char te: bde ba la gol na 'dod khams gsal ba la gol na gzugs khams mi rtog par gol na srid pa'i rtse mor 'phen te sa lam la 'jug pa'i skyes bu rnams kyi lam rtags su med thabs kyang med de rtag tu gol mi rung ba'i gnas su shes par bya'o: de la yang lam gyi zhi gnas rang kha ma zhes bya ste: der yun ring por zhig tu brtan pa thob na sems rgyud la brtan pa 'thob pa'i gnad yod kyang : snyigs ma'i dus 'dir sems dmu rgod la yun thung tsam las brtan thob can 'byung ba shin tu dkon pa yin pas shes par gyis shig: 'di'i dus 'ga' zhig la lhag pa'i lha shar nas der sems gnas pa dang : 'ga' zhig la zhing khams kyi bkod pa snang nas der brtan cing gnas pa dang : 'ga' zhig la bde gsal mi rtog pa gang yang rung ba khyad par ba byung nas der gnas pa dang : 'ga' zhig la bla ma dang 'ja' dang 'od dang thig le'i snang ba shar ba'i der gnas pa sogs ma nges par char ba gang zag rang rang gi rtsa dang khams kyi byed las kyis mtha' gcig tu 2

nges pa med par shes par gyis shig: yang stong chen mtha' yas pas:bcom ldan 'das de ltar nyams su blangs pas nyams rtogs ji ltar skye ba'i tshul rnams bstan du gsol: zhes zhus pas: bka' stsal pa: mya sems kyi rdo rje sngon rgyud lung man ngag thams cad du rtogs pa rjen la byung nas bstan pa las nyams kyi 'byung tshul zur tsam las mi ston pa ni khams dang dbang po'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa la nyams kyi myong ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod kyang mtha' gcig tu ma nges pa la dgongs nas spyi mthun du 'byung 'gyur de tsam las mi gsungs pa ni: de'i lan pa yin pas shes par gyis shig: 'dir nyams kyi 'char sgo sna tshogs ma nges par 'char ba bsam gyis mi khyab cing brjod kyis mi long ste: slob dpon nyams myong dang sa lam gyi lo rgyus shes pa mngon par shes pa dang ldan pa rnams kyis mngon par shes pa dang shes rab kyi stobs dang shugs kyis mkhyen zhing gsal ba yin: yang na rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin dang : tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin yan chad kyi nyams kyi 'byung tshul rgyus med cing thad kur mngon par shes pas mkhyen padang : min kyang khrid kyi sdeb kha bsgyur te dgongs pa gtad pas nyams lasagrol nus te: dper na ting 'dzin grub pa'i lha dang drang srong bram ze'u atsarya sogs kyis yi ge 'bru 'ga' re yid la byas te ting nge 'dzin bsgom pas las gang gi phyir bsgom kyang : phyis de'i phyir bzlas pas las de 'grub pa dang : nad gang gi phyir dmigs kyang : phyis skyes bu pho mo dag gis nadade'i phyir bzlas pas phan thogs pa ltar: rig pa 'dzin pa rnams kyis nadathams cad nyams su ngo sprad pa'am: de'i phyir bsgom bzlas kyi thabasabastan pas sngon las bzlog thabs med par 'ga' tsam ma gtogs pa sel30

bar 'gyur na: rnal 'byor pa'i nyams lam du slong ba lta ci smos: de dag gang yang ma yin na slob ma la khrid 'debs pa'i slob dpon blun po dag gis gang zag gcig gi rgyud la 'byung ba'i nyams snang kun la 'byung par 'dod na rang gzhan gnyis ka mgo bskor nas slob ma'i srog bdud du 'bab pa yin:ci'i phyir na phyi slong lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul dang ca nang slong lus kyi na tsha sna gas pa dang : gsang slong sems kyi bde sdug sogs nyams ma nges par byung srid de: slob dpon blun cing rmongs pa rnams kyis nyams slong ba'i rgyu sems khrid 'chad cing : nyams byung na nyams ngo mi shes par nyams nad du bzung ca rgyab brten 'dre ru gol: dogs pa 'chi ba la bya: blo gtad mo rtsis sman dpyad la byed dgos pa byung tshe: de dag tu'ang 'dre gdonaganod byed kyi ngo shar bas: las ka rim gro dang thabs sna tshogs la brtson srid de las ci byas kyang gnod par 'gro ba lta bu las phan pa til 'bru tsam mi byung zhing mthar 'chi ba las 'os med pa yin pas srog gcod kyi dug khong du gas pa lta bur gyur na slob ma'i srog bdud du bab pa de yin: 'di'i don la zhib tu dpyod la thabs mkhas par gyis shig: da lhag mthong la sogs pa'i ming gi sa gcod pa'i sgom spro phyir sa lam gyi rim pa mang por bshad payod kyang : 'dir rang lam la dran pa phyugs rdzi lta bu dang : rnam par rtog pa phyugs lta bu mngon du gyur te: trig hrig dang lhag lhag tu mngon zhing re dogs dga' sdug gi snang ba sna tshogs bar mi chad par 'byung srid pa'i 'jur bu'i dran pa zhes brjod pa yin: lar shar rig lam du byed pa rnams rang rang gi lam rtags su re 'ga' 'gyu rtog gang shar thams cad ri gzar rbab rdo gar phog pa'i sa la dong dang bshig bral (ral)chen po 'byurdo ba

par rtog pa shar tshad thams cad kyis snying la mi bde ba'i zug ju chen po mtshon rtse btsug pa lta bur gnod par 'char ba dang : gnas dga' 'gyu sdug gi snang ba dga' yal ye ba dang bde kyi le ba dang : snang ba thams cad rdul gyi rnam par snang ba'i kha dog gsal lam byed par snang ba dang : mgo yi skra rtse man chad nas rkang pa'i sen rtse yan chad kyi lus kyi phyi nang thams cad la na tsha so zin med par 'byung res byed pa dang : yang na ni nad nges pa canarlung mkhris bad yin la sogs pa 'du ba'i nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi gang rung gi rnam pas zug rngu sna tshogs kyis gdung bas bza' btung gnod pa'i snang ba dang : mi sogs gzhan la thugs 'phrad dang : khyim bsgrod khrom tshogs la sogs pas gnod pa'i snang ba sna tshogs kyis na tsha ma nges par 'byung srid de sman dpyad mo rtsis la re dgos pa'i dus 'byung ba dang :sems kyi thog tu sdug bsngal bzod blag med pa snying gas 'gro ba yin nam snyam pa dang : mtshan mo gnyid mi 'byung ba dang : gal te 'byung yang nad tshab chen pos btab pa'i nad pa ltar gnyid mi zin pa dang : sad pa'i dus su yang rmang po gces phrug dang bral ba'i snying sdug lta bus sems rgyud gang ste sdugabasngal nyams su myong ba dang : da dung bdag la kho thag chod pa'i go rgyu'am rig rgyu zhig yod snyam nas der skom pa chu la gdung ba lta bur 'byung ba dang myonyon mongs pa dug lnga'i rtog pa thams cad res mos su 'byung zhing ca bzod blag med par rjes su 'brang dgos pa'ang yod: skad 'gags pa dang :dbugs mi bde ba la sogs pa'i nyams kyi myong ba sna tshogs ma nges pa 'byung srid: sems kyi rtsal rnam par rtog pa thams cad bde sdug gang snang de ru 32

nyams pas nyams zhes bya ste brjed med du gnas pa yin: bde sdug gang snang thams cad brjed pa dang yal ba dus mnyam du 'byung ba yin: phyi 'byung ba'i sgra dang gzugs mthong tshad kyi bzhin la'ang nga la go rgyu'am shes rgyu yod snyam pa dang : bya dang byi'u'i skad sogs mthong tshor thams cad nga la rtags dang rten 'brel du go rgyu'am shes rgyu zhig red snyam nas bsam mno sna gsakhyed dgos pa dang : yang pha rol gyi mi khyi bya la sogs pa'i skad sgra dang : sgra skad thams cad snying la tsher mas btab pa lta bur snang ba dang :gzhan gyi gtam tshig lab pa thams cad rang la gshe zhing rgol bar snang bas zhe snang dang khong khro bzod med du skye ba dang : gzhan dag gis bre mo dang gad mo byed pa thos pa dang mthong yang de la mi dga' zhing rang la gshe skur du snanganas tshig ngan smra ba dang : rang gi sdug bsngal nyams su myong ba'i dbang gis gzhan dag mthong tshe de rnams kyi bde skyid la yid smon byed dgos pa 'byung ba dang : dogs pa rgyun mi chad pas rgyud gang nas mtshon dang grogs la'ang skrag cing 'jigs snang shar ba dang : snang ba thams cad re dogs sna tshogs nges pa med par 'char ba yin: 'di dus do nub mal du zhugs tshe sang gi na mo mi gzhan 'ong bar snang ba de'i byad dang bzhin dang shes rgyud dang tam brjod dang ca 'dre la sogs pa mthong ba'i snang ba shar nas der 'jigs skrag dang : khong khro dang chags sdang gi zhen pa dbang med du skyes te gnyid mi 'byung ba dang : res 'ga' ni bla ma la mos gus dang : dkon mchog la dad mos 'khor ba la nges 'byung dang skyo shas sems can la snying rjedrag po mig nas mchi ma thor thor du byung ba yang 'byung : res 'ga' ni sdug bsngal thams cad yul med du song nas nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa rdo snar

dwangs ba'i snga thog tu lha'am 'dre gang yang rung bas mgo dang yan lag don snying mngon sum du khyer ba'i shul du rlangs pa phyu ru ru thon pa dngos sam nyams sam rmi lam la snang ba'i rjes su sems kyi sdug bsngal thams cad yul med du song nas nam mkha' sprin dang bral ba lta bu'i snang ba dga' ya le bar 'gyur : 'di'i khongs su dran pa rnam pa bzhi dang bde rtsub kyi nyams kho nas rang bzhin ma nges par 'byung srid de mtha' gcig tu ma nges pa'i tshul rnams ji lta ba bzhin du lam 'di 'chad pa'i bshes gnyen rnams kyis shes shing rtogs dgos pa yin pa'i shes par gyis shig: me khams pa la bde nyams kyi shas che ba dang ca sa khams pa la 'thibs nyams shas che ba dang : chu khams pa la gsal nyams dang : rlung khams pa la rtsub nyams dang : nam mkha'i khams stong nyams kyi rang bzhin shas che ba yin no: nyams kyi bde rtsub thams cad dbyings su nub pa'i rjes su rnam par rtog pa la bzo bcos mi dgos par rang bab tu bzhag pas rang rig cing gang shar thams cad kyis phan med gnod med du song nas skabs gcig der gnas shing bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams khyad par ba re 'byung zhing lhar snang 'drer snang mngon shes phra mo 'byung ba yang yod: rtsa khams kyi byed las tha dad du yod pas mngon shes dang gsal snang mi 'byung ba shas che ba rlung khams pa dang sa khams pa shin tu mang ba'i byed las so: mngon shes mthong snang ni me khams pa dang chu khams pa la lhag par 'byung bar 'gyur ro: da sa mtshams kyi rim pa ming gi tha dad du dbye na: 'gyu dran gnyis ka gcig tu 'dres te dran pa rtse gcig tu lhag par mthong bas dran pa lhag mthong zhes bya ste: 'di dus yang gnas

zhe na sngar shin tu 'bad rtsol gyis bltas kyang 'og 'gyu dang bying rmug gi sgrib pas bsgribs nas mthong dka' ba la 'dir 'bad rtsol chen po ma byas kyang rnam par rtog pa gang shar mngon du gyur te lhag par mthong ba yin: 'di'i dus nyams snang ni rnal 'byor 'ga' zhig la gar bltas gang shar thams cad sku dang thig ler shig shig tu snang : 'ga' zhig la yig 'bru mi 'dra ba sna tshogs dang : 'od sna tshogs dang : gzugs 'dra min sna tshogs pa ma nges par 'char ro: 'ga' zhig la zhing khams dang : yul ngo mi shes pa dang :srog chags ngo mi shes pa sna tshogs kyis glu dang mgur ma gtam brjod byed pa dang : dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro mang pos gar byed cing rnam 'gyur sna tshogs ma nges par ston pa dang : 'ga' zhig la mthong tshor gyi gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya thams cad brda dang rten 'brel du ston pa'i snang ba ma nges para'achar ro: 'ga' zhig la gzugs yod dang gzugs med mang po mngonashes kyis mthong ba'i snang ba 'char ro: der rab tu goms pa'i mthar bdesdug gi nyams ma nges pa zhig la rkyen byas nas dran pa dang rnam par rtog pa gnyis ka gcig tu 'dres nas gang shar thams cad sbrul gyi mdud pa rang zhigapa ltar phyi'i yul la dum bur 'phros nas rang yal du 'gro bar snang bas rangagrol dang : shar rig dus mnyam du song nas (bas)rig pa tsam nas grolabar snang bas shar grol dus mnyam dang : rang klong nas (las) shar tsamanas rang klong du grol ba mkha' las glog 'khyugs pa mkha' klong du grol ba ltabur kha nang lta ru snang bas klong grol zhes pa dang : 'di dag thams cadadon la dran pa dang shar ba gcig tu 'dres te rtse gcig tu gyur par snang ba5

yin: de ltar nyams kyi snang ba bde sdug thams cad dbyings su sangs ba'i rjes su shes pa dwangs sang nge ba'i ngang du rang sar bzhag pas dran bsam gang shar thams cad la myong zhen gyis bzo bcos dang rtsis gdab med par shugs 'byung gi ngang du yan pas mngon du gyur pa la 'jur dran gyi rnam par rtog pa ltar gsal gsal hrig hrig gyi 'dzin rtsol rang zhig pas blo yid mi tshims par yid yul du 'bad rtsol byed dgos pa dang : ma tshang ba dang : ma rnyed pa zhig yod par snang ba'i blo yid gtad pa dang : bsgrim pa la sogs pa'i yid dpyod mang po bar bar du byed dgos pa 'byung ste: 'di dus shes pa rang gi ngang la gnas shing dran pa mngon du gyur te myong zhen chung ba rang bab las bzo bcos med pa'i ngang du gyur pa rang bab kyi dran pa ces bya ba'i thog tu phebs pa yin no: de'i nyams snang yang bde nyams lhod lhod 'jol 'bol ba shes pa gsal dwangs nge ba rnam par rtog pas phan med gnod med kyang bzo bcos spang len mi dgos shing gnas nyams shas che ba rnams 'byung bas 'di dus bshes gnyen bzang pos ma zin na da ni bdag gis lta sgom khyad par can gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa su la'ang med pa rtogs dka' ba zhig rgyud la skyes yod pa yin snyam nas blo gtod dang yid ches kyi ngang du dus 'das nas gzhan la bsgro gleng mi byed cing rang mgo 'khor ba dang : bshes gnyen gzhan la smras kyang gang zag smra mkhas pa dang : bshes gnyen nyan dpyod mkhas pa ma gtogs skabs 'di la bab tshe lam gyi rig pa dang nor sa che bas de thog tu lus nas mi tshe der 'das nas srid pa'i khams las mi 'da' ba'iskyon des 'ching ba yin pas shes par gyis shig: dran pas dri ma tsam yod pas nyams kyi snang ba des bskyed de rgyun mi chad pa yin: khyad par du gsal

nyams kyis lha 'dre mthong ba dang : rnam par rtog pa la 'dre gdon glo buradu shar ba re 'ga' bden srid cing de mngon shes su bzung nas lha 'dre yidal yang yang byas pa'i mthar snang ba 'dre gdon du mched cing rtogs pas lha'adre bzos pas gzhan la mngon shes bshad pa'i mthar 'dre sgom pa 'grub stergyud 'dre gdon gyis brlabs nas sdom pa dang dam tshig nyams: chos dang gang zag las ring du 'gro ste: 'jig rten tshe 'di'i bya ba la 'byams shing:gto yas la mgo 'khor: chog shes spu tsam med par zas nor gyi phyir 'brang nas zhen chags 'dod sred kyis rgyud 'ching bzhin 'chi ba'i nang bar la gtugs pa'i mthar 'dre gdon gdug pa can du skyes te mkha' rgyu'i yi dwags kyi yul dang sdug bsngal nye bar len pa'i rgyu bsags pa las lta sgom log parasong nas 'khor ba mtha' med du 'khrul pa'i las bsags pa yin te dbang po 'bring dang tha ma rnams lam 'di ru zhugs tshe lam rtags su med thabs kyang med pa yin te: gang la'ang snang bas 'ching ba ma yin te snang tsam gyis ngo shes pa'i chog pa yin no: zhen na ni zhen pas 'ching ste nyams rdzun po che la blo gtad dang yid ches med par shes nas mngon zhen dang re dogs dgag sgrub mi byed par rang sar bzhag pas rang ngor grol nas tshugs mi thub par na bun nam mkha' la yal ba lta bu yin pa'i shes par gyis shig: kye sems kyi rdo rje nyams bzang ngan gyi bye brag nges pa med par zhi gnas kyi dus nas shes rig mngon du ma gyur gyi bar du nyams bsgrub pa'i thabs kho na yin pas 'di mi 'byung bya ba gcig kyang med de thams cad nyams nges pa ru thag bcad pa gnad kyi dam pa dang : gdams pa'i yang snying du shes nas rtogs shig zungs shig: stong chen mtha' yas na re: bcom ldan 'das de ltar 7

nyams bde rtsub thams cad rnam mkhyen gyi lam la mi nye zhing so zin med pa yin na nyams bsgrub pas phan pa med na ci'i phyir sgom sgrub byed dgos pa gang lags ston pa nyid kyis bstan du gsol: zhes zhus so: bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa: kye sems kyi rdo rje gang zag blo rtsing pa dang rnam par rtog pa rgod cing las su mi rung ba dang : dbang po rtul po lam ngo mi 'phrod pa rnams lam 'di'i sgo ru gzud pa'i dran rtsal khams su bcag nas blo yid je brtan du song ste brjed med du brtan pa thob pa las: rnam rtog rgod pa dang blo rtsing pa'i rigs rnams la shes rig ngo sprad kyang nyams su mi len zhing le lo dang rnam g.yengs su kha 'khyol ba'i skyon dang : gal srid nyams su blang yang brjed nges kyi dbang gis 'khrul sa (pa) rgya 'byams su 'chor ba'i skyon yod pa'i phyir sems mi 'phye bo lta bu dang rlung rta nod long ba lta bu nyams dang 'dzin pa'i rtod phur gyis bcing nas 'dul bar bkol ba lta bu'i ched dang : dbang po rtul pos bsam pa gtan la phabs nas dran 'dzin dang shes bzhin gyi chings kyis bcings pas nyams dang goms 'dris kyi dbang sa rnam par rtog pa phra rags thams cad zad pa dang dag song ba'i snang ba shar nas mthar shes pa bzo med bcos med bsgom rgyu med pa'i ngang mngon du ra nas rig pa sgom med chen po'i thog tu sleb tshe bla mas de ngo sprad pa las ga' tshegs dang nor sar mi 'chor ba'i ched du dang po dka' tshegs chen sa lam btsal ba rnam rtog 'gyu ba la lam byed pa dang : mthar thug shes rang thog tu phebs tshe lam du ngo sprad pa yin: lam gyi rig pa'i shes pa zo med mngon gyur gyi rang thog tu phebs pa'i sngon du nyon yid slong ba'i masdu sngon bshad zin pa'i rtsub nyams dang 'dra mtshungs pa zhig rim bzhin

bsgrod dgos pa'i lam du mi 'byang mi srid pa yin noX zhes gsangs soXri rin /rngon ra rib (5yang byang chub sems dpa' stong chen mtha' yas na re: bcom ldan 'das rnam par rtog pa dag bya yin nam (min) : gal te dag bya yin na sems dag nas shes pa slad du skye dgos pa yin nam: bcom ldan 'das kyis bstan du gsol: zhes zhus pa la: ston pa nyid kyis bkame stsal pa: kyi mas kyi rdo rje dran pa dang 'dzin pa'i 'ching ba rnams nyams stobs kyis rim pa bzhin du zhig nas mthar sems can rang kha ma lta bu sems rang gar yan pas rnam par rtog pa bag nyal du song nas mi mngon pa lta bur 'gyu rtog dbyings su nub nas kun gzhi stong had de ba bdag gzhan yul gsum mi snang ba'i ngang thog tu phebs pa dang : stong gsal myong zhen can kha nang du bltas te bdag gzhan yul gsum gyi snang ba mi mngon pa zhig 'char ba ni: kun gzhi'i rnam shes yin te: thog phebs kyi kun gzhi rnam pa gnyis slob dpon 'ga' zhig gis ro gcig dang spros bral du 'chad pa dang : la las lung ma bstan du 'chad pa'ang yod de: gang ltar smra yang don la ngo bo'i stong du phebs pa yin: slar yang gang zag brtson 'grus dang ldan pas 'di lam nga dag pa ma yin par thag bcad de bsgom pas de ltar myong zhen can gyi stong dang stong gsal thams cad gnyid las sad pa bzhin du dbyings su ngas nas phyi'i snang ba go ma 'gags shing nang gi dran 'dzin gyi spun thag chad nas sgom pa bzang po'i gzeb kyis ma bcing : ma rig pa ngan pas rang khar ma song : lha sgom spyod pa'i chings kyis ma bcings pa'i ye gnas kyi shes pa dwangs sal le ba shes dang shes bya 'di zhes bdag dang yul ma grub pa ye nas rang byung ba yid la myong pa med de ngang du zhen pa bral ba bsam mno dang

tad so med pa yang khrol le ba zhig gi thog tu phebs tshe rtsal go ma 'gags pas snang ba thams cad mngon du gyur pa: sems can gyi rnam par rtog pa lta ba yul la 'dres shing yul dang gnyis med du yal ba: dum bur 'phro ba:migs pa dang bcas pa ni gcig kyang med de sems can gyi rnam par rtog pa dag pa yang ma yin te: yid shes rab la go 'phos: rtsal ye shes su go 'phos nas der brtan pa thob pa yin te: dper na rnyog ma dwangs pa'i chu lta bu yin pas shes par gyis shig: ces gsungs so: de nas byang chub sems dpa' gsal khyab kyi dbang po stan las langs te bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces zhus so: kyi ston pa bcom ldan 'das khyab bdag mi g.yo ba'i rgyal po gsan cing dgongs su gsol: 'dir gsal rig bsam brjod thams cad dang bral ba ye nas rang byung 'di gas rnam par grol pa'i sa thob bam mi thob: lar 'thob nges na ji ltar 'thob: mi thob na 'di bsgom pa'i dgos ched gang lags: yon tan ji lta bu 'byung bar 'gyur ba gdul bya rnams kyi don du bstan du gsol: zhes zhus pa la: ston pa nyid kyis bka' stsal pa: kyi gsal khyab dbang po khyod rab tu nyon la yid la zungs shig dang ca ngas khyod la yang dag par bshad do: lam zab mo shes rig spros pa dang bral ba 'di nyid kyi ngang du brtan pa thob par nyams su blangs kyang chos sku gzhir gnas kyi ye shes ma rtogs na gzugs kyi khams dang mubazhi'i khams su tshe 'phros ma thag tu 'phen pa'i stobs yod pa las 'di rangagis rnam mkhyen gyi sangs rgyas 'thob mi srid de: lam 'di dang po ngo 'phrodanas nan cher bsgom pa'i stobs kyis chos sku gzhir gnas kyi ye shes ngo 'phrodapa/ gyur na lam shes rab dang ye shes kyi rtsal yin pas yon tan yang 'di lta

dang: chu phor nang gi chu las lhag pa'i chu gzhan na med pa ltar du shes rig mngon gyur gyi lam 'di las gzhan pa'i lam gzhan med de: mar ma dag pa 'khor bar 'khyams yang shes pa rgyun chags kyis bzos pa dang : yar bsod nams kyi las dkar po'i dge ba dang ca lha bskyed bsgom bzlas kyis bsgrub cing shes pa rgyun chags kyis grub pa dang : rtsa thig rlung gsum rdo rje gsum gyi rol bar sbyang ba yang shes pa rgyun chags kyis chos can gyi snang ba chos nyid kyi dbyings su grol bar byed pa yang : gzhi ka dag dang : ye shes dwangs gsal rang byung gnyis su med pa mngon du gyur pa nyid dang :lar theg pa gang du 'jug kyang ye gnas kyi ye shes rgyun chags pa zhig las 'jug pa'i sgo ma mchis pa yin: tha mal 'khrul ba'i sems can gyis ngag 'don grangs mang po brjod nas dge bar dmigs pa'i gzhi dang shes pa rgyun chags pa'i ched du bstan pa de bzhin du shes pa rgyun chags pas las thams cad bsags pa yin pas shes pa mngon gyur 'di ga zag bcas dge ba gang gis kyang 'gran zla dang bral ba yin: der yang shes pa rgyun chags pa'i thabs bsgrub pa dang : shes pa mngon du byed pa gnyis ka la khyad par gnam sa tsam yod pas mngon gyur 'di ni khyad par 'phags pa yin pas yon tan thams cad rdzogs pa yin: kyi rigs kyi bu ye gnas kyi ye shes ni sems can sems rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba snang sems thams cad la dmigs pa med cing mngon du byed pa 'di ga shes rab kyi phyi gdangs yin: de mngon ra gyi rang bzhin ni shes rab kyi nang gdangs yin te khyad shin tu che ba mkha' dbyings la nam lang ba lta bu'o: brtson 'grus can dbang rab tu 4

ra pa rnams kyis bar dang mtshams med par rtse gcig tu nyams su blangs nas snying po mi 'gyur ba'i sgrub pa la brtson na mthar so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes rtsal du 'bar bas chos nyid de bzhin nyid kyi gnas lugs mngon du gyur te 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i lta sgom gyi yon tan phyin ci ma log pa mngon du gyur te gdod ma'i ye gzhi kun tu bzang por sangs rgyas par 'gyur ba yin: de ltar ma yin pa'i gang zag rnams kyis kyang ma bcos rang byung gi shes pa ma bsgom mngon du gyur pa'i gnad 'di ngo 'phrod cing 'di la cung zad brtan pa thob na de nyid las gzhan pa'i lus ngag gi dge ba ni stong gsum gyi bsags pa thams cad gcig tu bsdus yang de'i bsod nams kyi tshad brgya stong khri 'bum gyi char nye ba ma yin te: srid pa'i rtse mor yun ring du brtan pa 'thob par nges pa'o: zhes gsungs so: yang byang chub sems dpa' gsal khyab dbang po na re: kye ston pa bcom ldan 'das khyab bdag mi g.yo ba'i rgyal po gsan cing dgongs su gsol: de ltar sems la lam byed pa'i sems sde dang : shes pa la lam byed pa de'i 'bras bu rnams gang gis kyang mthar grol ba'i lam la ma 'phang ca sangs rgyas pa'ang ma yin na: de lta bu'i lam thag ring pa sa dang lam du bsgrod dka' zhing bde sdug sna tshogs myong ba las 'bras bu ma grub pa 'di la mi ltos par ka dag rdzogs pa chen po mtha' grol rig pa'i rgyal po mngon sum rang thog tu ngo 'phrod pa'i thabs dang lam gyi rim pa dka' tshegs med cing nor 'khrul du mi 'chor ba'i gdams pa zab mo bstan du gsol: zhes zhus so: bka' stsal pa: kyi rigs kyi bu 'dir thegapa thams cad kyi spyi gzhi chen po zab mo stong pa nyid yin te: zab mo stodwa ༵ nyid kyi don 'di ltar gtan la dbab pa'i tshul ngas bshad kyis legs

par nyon cig: khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad 'khrul gzhi ni bdag nyid gcig pu'i ma rig pa yin te: 'di'i byung gnas 'gro gsum gyi zhi rtsa la ltos shig: nga zhes bya ba 'di dang po byung ba'i gzhi dang rtsa ba la brtags pas byung ba'i khung ma grub pa'i stong pa nyid yin te: gzhi khyab brdal nam mkha'i 'khor yug la bdag tu 'dzin pa'i shes pa rgyun chags te snang sems thams cad med bzhin du snang tsam las ma grub pa yin pas byung ba'i khung stong : bar du gnas pa'i sa la brtags pas mgo bo la mgo bo sa nga zhes pa'i ming mi gnas pa bzhin du skra ni skra las nga ma yin: mig ni mig las nga ma yin: rna ba ni rna ba las nga ma yin: sna ni sna zhes bya ba las nga ma yin: lce la'ang lce zhes pa las nga yi ming mi gnas: so ni so las nga ma yin: sog pa ni sog pa las nga ma yin: de bzhin du dpung pa ni nga ma yin: lag ngar ni nga ma yin: 'chang mthil lag rgyab sor mo rnams ni nga ma yin: sgal tshigs ni nga ma yin: rtsib ma rnams ni nga ma yin: glo ba dang snying ni nga ma yin: mchen pa dang mchin khri ni nga ma yin: rgyu ma dang mtsher ba mkhal ma rnams ni nga ma yin: sdun dang rgyab ni nga ma yin: brladang dpyi dang rje ngar bol ba sor tshigs thams cad kyang rang rang gi ming las nga ma yin: wags pa dang tshil dang sha khrag chu ser rtsa rgyus ba spu thams cad la'ang rang rang gi ming las gdags pa'i sa ma grub: nga zhes bya ba lus kyi smad du gnas na mgo dang yan lag bcad kyang zug rdu dang na tsha 'byung bsader mi gnas: stod du gnas na rkang pa dang ro smad la gnod pa byung yangan tsha mi 'byung : nang na gnas na'ang phyi'i ba spu breg pas kyang tsha ba'i zugarngu 'byung don med pas der yang mi gnas: lus la gnas snyam na go~X rgyan

sa nor longs spyod thams cad gzhan gyis khyer ba dang : spyod par snang 'ang mi bde ba'i zug rngu dang chags sdang bzod med du byung na de ru yang mi gnas: phyi'i yul la gnas sam snyam na snod bcud thams cad nga yi bar dzin zhing don la'ang rang rang gi ming tha dad pa las nga ma grub: nga las zhan pa'i snod bcud snang ba thams cad so sor grub par snang na'ang rmi snang dang 'di snang dang phyi ma'i snang ba kun tu bdag dang snang ba thams cad lus dang grib ma chu dang rlan me dang tsha ba bzhin du snang bas snod bcud thams cad nga yis dbang byas kyang : nga ni ci la'ang mi gnas pa'o: nga zhes bya ba'i 'phrul mo che khams gsum gyi byed po 'di tha ma 'gro ba'i yul la brtags shing dpyad na snang srid thams cad kyi gzhi dang ngo bor gyur pas na 'gro ba'i yul rang stong pa dang : khams gsum thams cad ngar 'dzin gyi dbyings su shar na de las gzhan pa'i 'gro yul thams cad zad pa yin: 'gro ba'i bdag po yang ma byung zhing mi gnas na bdag po yul med du rang thal ba'o:zhes gsungs pa la: yang gsal khyab dbang po na re: de ltar byung gnas 'gro gsum med cing ma grub par nges na snang ba nas snang ba brgyud pa gang lags ston pa nyid kyis bstan du gsol: zhes zhus pa la: bka' stsal pa: kyi rigs kyi bu ngar 'dzin gyi shes pa mngon du gyur nas rang klong du nga dang nga yi ba'i snang ba mched cing : slar yang rang klong du yal nas gzhi stong nyid lung ma bstan du 'byams klas pa res mos su mched sdud byed pas rmi snang dang : nyin snang khams gsum gyi snang ba thams cad ma bsgrod med bzhin snang tsam du shar ba yin pas 'gro sa dang 'gro mkhan gyi yul bdag ma grub pa yin te shes par gyis shig: nga bdag gi 'dzin pa rgya dang rgyun mi

chad pa la gang zag gi bdag 'dzin zhes bya'o: zhes gsungs pa la: yang byang chub sems dpa' gsal khyab dbang po na re: mya ston pa bcom ldan 'das de ltar ngar 'dzin dbyings su nub pa'i tshe rgyun chad pa min nam ston pa nyid kyis bstan du gsol: zhes zhus pa la: bka' stsal pa: kye:rigs kyi bu ngar 'dzin gyi snang sems dbyings su nub pa'i tshe na'ang gzhi rang gi yon tan mngon du ma gyur pa'i lung ma bstan de bdag 'dzin gyi rgyu yin pas rgyu ma rig pa de ga gang zag gi bdag 'dzin zhes bya ba yin no: zhes gsungs so: yang gsal khyab dbang po na re: ston pa bcom ldan 'das phyi yul gyi stong tshul ji lta bu lags: ston pa nyid kyis bstan du gsol:zhes zhus pa la bka' stsal pa: nga las gzung pa chos kyi bdag 'dzin mched pa 'di dag gi ming dang dngos po mtshan ma thams cad ma grub pa'i tshul brtags pa las: dang po ming gi gdags gzhi brtag pa la lus kyi ming rnams stong par gtan la dbab pa ni: mgo zhes bya ba de gang la btags brtags pas: sku ni skra las mgo bo ma yin: mig ni mig las mgo ma yin: rna ba ni rna ba nyid las mgo ma yin: sna ni sna las mgo ma yin:lce ni lce las mgo ma yin: de bzhin du pags pa dang : sha dang : rus pa dang : khrag dang : chu ser rtsa rgyus sogs thams cad la rang rang gi nga so sor snang tsam las mgo bo zhes ma grub pa'o: zhes gsungs pa la:gsal khyab dbang po na re: ston pa bcom ldan 'das de ltar so sor dbye na ma grub cing: lhan gcig tu tshogs pa la mgo zhes bya ba ma yin nam: zhes zhus pa la yang bka' stsal pa: rigs kyi bu spyir rgyu de dag lhan cig tshogs pa la mgo mi btags pa mang po 'dug pa la ltos shig: gzhan yang ma/ /sa

bya ba rdul phran du btang nas rdul tshogs par byas nas gzhan su la bstan kyang mgo ming du mi smra ba dang : yang chu yis bsgril te ril bu byas kyang mgo yi nga ma grub pa dang : lus snang ba'i tshe na mgo yi bya byed pas mgo bo de la ming dang dngos po btags don yod pa min na mgo med pa la snang tsam las stongapa yul med yin te: mi lam gyi mgo bo snang ba dang : nyin snang gi dus kyi mgo bo dang ca 'das pa'i dus su snang ba'i mgo bo dang stu ma 'ongs pa'i dus su snang bar 'gyur ba'i mgo bo rnams gcig tu 'dug pa la rma dang skrang dang lba ba rmen dang sme sha thams cad kyang dus rnams kun tu snang dgos pa la de mi 'dra bar ston pa dang : mgo bo so sor tha dad pa yin na de ltar mgo snga ma thams cad bor ba'am: yang na ni ye nas ma grub pa'i mtshang ston te: steng gi phyogs su gyen du blta ba'i phyir brjod pa yin zhe na: stenga'og nam mkha' la dpyad dgos pas nam mkha'i mgo mjug steng 'og gang lags brtags pas der mgo mjug ma grub pa'o: de bzhin du mig ces bya ba gang la gdags she na'ang: chu bur thams cad la mig gi ming mi grub:pags pa dang : khrag dang : tshil dang : rtsa rgyus rnams la mig gi mingam grub ste: gong bzhin du lhan du tshogs pa la mig ma grub: gzugasamathong ba'i cha bar la mig smra'o snyam naX 'das ma 'ongs da lta rmi snang dang ༷sa rdo༅ri'i bye /rdo// //rganyin snang thams cad du gzugs mthong mkhan chu bur 'di nyid yin nam ltosashig dang : shes pas rang snang mngon du byed pa nyid las: mig rdo dungaphyur lag tu thogs nas phyogs su bltas kyang gzugs mi mthong : shes panyid las mig chu bur ma yin te mig med: rna ba zhes pa de ltar sha lpags rtsargyus khrag dang chu ser sbu gu dang bcas pa la rang rang gi ming las rna ba'i ming

snang dang : phyi snang dang rmi snang dang nyin snang kun tu sgra thos mkhan rnams 'di yin nam brtags pa'i de ring kho nas thos mkhan bug sgo 'di ga yin pa las snang dus gzhan du ni thos mkhan sems kyi shes pa yin par go na shes pa la rna ba'i ming gdags pa las rna ba'i gzugs tshang pa'i rna ba grangs med pa ga tu thogs nas nyan kyang sgra mi thos na rna ba ye nas med cing ma grub: sna yang de bzhin du ming dang dngos mtshan la brtags shing dpyad pa byas na sha dang rus pa khrag dang chu ser rtsa rgyus sbu gu thams cad la rang rang gi ming tha dad pas sna ma grub pa dang : lhan cig tu tshogs pa la'ang sna ma grub ste:dri tshor ba la sna zhes brjod pas bug sgo 'di nas dri tshor ba yin snyam na: mi lam dang skye lus gzhan snang gi dus su dri su la snang zhe na sems kyi shes pas tshor ba las bug sgo 'di mi dgos te bar do'i rnam par shes pas kyang dri tshor bas sems yid shes la sna med pas sna yul med du thag chod par 'gyur: lce yang de bzhin du sha khrag pags pa rtsa rgyus so so ru phyes kyang lce ma grub pa dang 5de dag lhan cig tu tshogs pa la'ang lce'i ming ma grub pa dang : ro myong mkhan yin pas lce ru brjod pa yin par 'dod na rmi lam bar do skye lus kun gyi dus su ro myong mkhan 'di ga yin nam min: min na ni sems yid shes kyis ro myong bas de la lce yi ming ma grub: lce dung phyur mngar skyur du sbyar yang ro mi myong bas shes par 'gyur: lus zhes bya ba yang pags pa dang tshiladang sha dang khrag dang rkang dang rus pa rtsa rgyus thams cad la so sor brtagasapas lus ma grub: de rdul dang rdul phran du phab nas lhan gcig tu tshogasapar byas kyang lus kyi ming mi gnas: chu yis bsgril nas lhan gcig hril47

lam du reg bya myong mkhan dang : bar do ru reg bya myong mkhan lus 'di ga yin nam min: de ma yin na myong mkhan de su yin brtags pas sems rnam par shes pa nyid yin par thag bcad pas sems la lus kyi ming mi thogs pas lus med: yang lag pa zhes bya ba'i gnas la brtags pas sog pa ni lag pa ma yin: dpung pa ni lag pa ma yin: lag ngar ni lag pa ma yin:chang mthil dang sor mo yang ma yin pasaḥ lag pa gang yin ngos zungs dang zhes brjod na: de ring lag pa'i bya ba byed par bsgrub pa 'di la lag par smra ba yin zhe na: 'o na rmi lam na lag pa'i bya ba byed pa'i lag par snang ba dang rtsi bar do de ltar snang ba thams cad 'di yin nam brtags na de ni ma yin te sems la snang ba tsam yin par thag chod na sems la lag pa gdags pa las lag pa ma grub pa'o: yang sog pa la brtags pas sha ni sog pa ma yin: rus pa dang rtsa rgyus ni sog pa ma yin: so sor phyes kyang ma grub rdul phran du phabs pa'i phye ma lhan cig tshogs kyang ma yin: chu yis 'dags pa lhan gcig bsgril kyang ma yin pa de bzhin du lhu tshigs thams cad la zhib tu brtags shing ming gi gdags gzhi yul med du gtan la phab par bya'o:pha rol na mi snang ba'i mi gang la gdags: mgo bo ni mi ma yin: dbang po lnga ni mi ma yin: sha khrag rus pa rkang dang rtsa rgyus yan lag dang nying lag rnamapar shes pa dang bcas pa la mi yi ming ma grub: de bzhin du khang pa zhes bya ba gdags pa'i gzhi gang lags na sa ni khang pa ma yin: rdo la ni rdo nyid las khang ba'i ming ma grub: ka ba phyam dang gral ma dang sa 'dzin rnamasala'ang khang pa zhes pa'i ming ma grub: de dag lhan gcig tu sbrung (spangs 48

ma yin: nang ni ma yin: kha dang mthil yang ma yin: shing yang ma yin: so sor phyes pa'am lhan cig 'tshogs kyang gdags gzhi yul med pa'o: ri bo zhes bya ba yang : sa ni ri bo ma yin: rdo ni ma yin: rtsa dang shing ni ma yin: de dag lhan cig tu tshogs yang ri bo ma yin pas ri bo'i ming stong pa'o: dbyug pa gcig pu la'ang ming gi gdags gzhi brtags pas rtse mo la rtse mo las dbyug pa ma grub: ting pa la rting pa las ma grub: shing la'ang shing las ma grub: bsreg pa'i thal ba la thal ba las ma grub: brdung ba'i rdul la rdul las dbyug pa ma grub pas ming de'ang yul med du yal ba las ma grub pa'o: sa dang chu dang me dang rlung rnams kyang rdul gyi khong na ma grub: rdul phran gyi khong na ma grub: rdul cha med kyi khong na'ang ma grub par shes par gyis shig: ming gi bye brag rnam grangs thams cad sgyu ma la sgyu ma med par sgyu ma ming tsam gyis zad pa dang : smig rgyu la smig rgyu med bzhin ming tsam du zad pa dang : mi lam la'ang rmi lam med bzhin du ming tsam gyis zad pa dang : gzugs brnyan la'ang gzugs brnyan ma grub par gzugs brnyan ming tsam du zad pa dang : dri za'i grong khyer la'ang ming tsam gyis zad pa dang : brag cha la'ang brag cha med par ming brjod pa'i tshig de las yul med pa dang : chu zla 'ang chu zla tshig tu zad pa dang : chu bur yang chu bur brjod pa'i tshig tsam las yul ma grub pa dang : mig yor yang ming las yul ma grub pa dang : sprul ba yang ming tshig brjod pa tsam sa ma grub pa la ming gi sgra brjod pa de bzhin du snang ba'i ming tshig brjod pa'i gdags gzhi thams cad med cing ma grub pa'i stong pa nyid yin te:

nga pa yul med du thag chod cing stong nyid nam mkha'i klong yangs su 'gag bsdam pa man ngag go: ces gsungs so: yang byang chub sems dpa' sal khyab dbang po na re: kyi ston pa bcom ldan 'das gdul bya blo rmongs nga bden zhen gyis 'ching ba rnams kyis ming gi gdags gzhi med pa tsam gyis gzhi chos nyid kyi gnas lugs mi rtogs pas rtog pa phra rags gnyis kyi sgo nas med pa'i ngang tshul gtan la dbab pa'i tshul ston pa nyid kyis bstan du gsol: zhes zhus so: bka' stsal pa: kye gsal khyab dbang po 'di ltar snang ba'i shing gi sdong po zhig snang na sdong po 'di yod pa rtag pa yin nam: med pa cang med yin nam brtags shing dpyad pa ni: yod pa rtag pa yin srid na: mi chod pa: mi shig pa: bden pa: sra ba: brtan pa: thams cad du thogs pa med pa: thams cad du ma pham pa dang ldanapar nges dgos pa can yin te: sdong po 'di la sta res btab pas rma byung bas na: chod pa dang : mang du btab pa'i bsheg tshe shig pa dang :gcig gi mang po red pa'i mi bden par rdzun pa dang : de dkar nag gi kha dog dang rdul gyi bslad btab pas bslad 'jug pas mi sra ba ste snyi ba dang :dus dang rkyen gyis 'pho 'gyur can du grub pas mi brtan pa dang : yul gangal thogs rdug can du gyur pas thogs pa: 'di la las ci byas kyang shing 'di pham par gyur pas pham pa ste: rdo rje'i chos gcig tsam yang mi tshang na medapa nges pa ru thag gcod par bya'o: zhes gsungs so: yang gsal khyabadabang po na ro: ston pa bcom ldan 'das rdo rje'i chos bdun tshang ba'i rdo rje'adi gang lags bstan du gsol: zhes zhus pas bka' stsal pa: kyigasal khyab dbang po kun rdzob rdzas kyi rdo rje zhes bya ba med pa dang : ma grub
