mthong nas nyams len la skabs skabs su brtson pa dag la 'od gsal lhun grub la thim pa zhes bya ba bdag snang tsam gyis shes pa zhig langs te: phyogs gang du bltas bas yul snang thams cad 'ja' ris kyis gang ba'i za 'og khaphyes pa lta bu'i 'od kyi gdeng chen pos yongs su gang zhing khyab par 'char ro:de 'bras kyi ljang pa lta bu ste de'i thog tu snye ma byung ba lta bur thig le che ba gnam sa kheb pa tsam dang : chung ba nya mig tsam gyi bar du grangs mang bsnang bas gar khyab thams cad gang bar 'char ro: snye ma la 'bras bu smin pabazhin du dang po thig le chen po gcig gi klong du rnam par snang mdzad yab yum gtso bor bzhugs pa'i 'khor byang chub sems dpa' sems ma bzhi dang: bcas pa 'char te: sku de dag gi thugs ka nas 'od kyi snam bu dkarapo bltar mi bzod pa rang gi spyi bor zug pa'i stong du dung gi phor pa kha sbub palta bu'i thig le brtsegs mas brgyan par 'char ro: de ni rnam par snangamadzad khong seng gi lam zhes bya ba yin no: de dang mnyam du dud 'gro'i rgyudalam sngo la bkrags mdangs chung ba zhig gshibs te 'char ro: gnasaskabs 'dir bab tshe sngar gyis sbyangs pa'i 'od gsal bu lta bu dang slad du sharaba'i snang ba ma lta bu gnyis dus 'dzom ba'i gnas skabs la bab tshe the tshomamed par ma bang du bu 'jug pa lta bur shes pas 'od gsal la 'jug pa'i gnad dang ldan na zung 'jug bde ba chen por brtan pa dang grol ba thob bar gyur ro: der ngo ma shes pa'i dbang gis ma grol na snang ba thams cad 'od mar gyi rol bar 'phros pa'i klong du thig le gnam sa 'brel ba tsam gyi nang snang ba mtha' yas yab yum gtso bor bzhugs pa'i 'khor byang chub sems 47

'od kyi snam bu dmar po rang gi mgrin par zug pa'i steng du padma rā ga'i phor pa kha sbub pa lta bu'i thig le brtsegs mas brgyan par 'char ro: de dang mnyam du yi dwags kyi rgyud lam 'od dmar skya bkrag mdangs med pa zhig 'char te: 'di dus rang snang rang ngo shes pa sku dang 'od gdangs chen po ru bsre 'pho byas te gzhan du ma yongs par gdeng tshugs pas grol ba thob ba yin no: der ngo ma shes pa'i dbang gis ma grol na snang ba thams cad 'od gdangs mthing nag gis yongs su kheb cing khyab ba'i klong du mi bskyod pa yab yum gtso bor bzhugs pa'i 'khor byang chub sems dpa' sems ma bzhi dang bcas pa mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras shing longs spyod rdzogs sku'i chas kyis brgyan pa'i thugs ka nas 'od kyi snam bu mthing nag bltar mi bzod pa rang gi snying gar zug pa'i steng du baiḍūrya'i por pa kha sbub pa lta bu'i thig le brtsegs mas brgyan par 'char ro: de dang mnyam du de'i 'og nas dmyal ba'i rgyud lam 'od nag po bkrags mdangs med pa zhig 'char te: 'di dus kyangashes pa sku'i dbyings su bsres te gdangs rang sar bzung bas mngon paradaga' ba'i zhing khams su grol ba thob par 'gyur ba yin: der ma grol nasnang ba thams cad 'od gdangs ser po'i rol par 'phos shing mched pa'iklong du thig le ser po bse phub lta bu rgya che la khyon yangs pa'i nang du sna tshogasapadma dang nyi zla'i steng du bcom ldan 'das rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu longs spyod rdzogs sku'i chas kyis brgyan te yum dang 'khrilab gzi brjid 'od phung bltar mi bzod pa 'bar ba g.yas su sems dpa'akun tu bzang po dang g.yon du sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po mdun du48

phrog pa lta bu'i 'od phung rab tu 'bar ba: sku de dag gi thugs ka nas 'odakyi snam bu ser po rang gi lte bar zug pa'i stong du thig le ser po sbur len gyi phor pa kha sbub pa lta bu'i thig le brtsegs mas brgyan par 'char ro: de dngamanyam du de'i 'og nas lha yi rgyud lam dkar po 'od dang bkrags mdangasamed pa zhig gshibs te 'char ro: rin chen 'byung ldan khong seng gi lam dungo shes shing bsre 'pho byed pa'i gnad dang ldan na lho phyogs dpal dang ldan pa'i zhing khams la dbang bsgyur te grol ba thob par 'gyur ro: de dag ni yeshes bzhi sbyor gyi lam zhes bya ba yin te gsang chen bla na med pa'i myur lamaskad cig ma dang por ngo shes gnyis pas gdeng thob gsum pas grol ba thobapar 'gyur ro: dag pa'i lam snang la blta mi bzod cing gtad mi tshugasate: ma dag pa'i lam bzhi ru bsres shing gtad pas gnas rigs de ru skye srid 'dzin par 'gyur ro: nyams snang gong 'phel gyi rtsal ma rdzogs kyi bar du don yod grub pa khong seng gi lam ni snang bar mi 'gyur te rtsal rdzogs phanachad nas rig pa tshad phebs kyi skabs tshun chad du bar do med par sangs rgyas te snang bar mi 'gyur ro: de nas sku dang thig le'i snang ba je nyung du song nas dung khang nas khrag 'thung rol pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad me las me stag 'phro ba bzhin du stong phyogs kyi nam mkhar 'phros shing khyab pas re re las kyang bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros nas snang srid kyi khams thams cad khyab cing gang nas spyan mig nas nyi zla 'bum gyi 'od dang zer lta bu mched pa: zhal gdangs shing mche ba zla ltar gtsigs pa: sma ra las me 'bar zhing smin ma sa glog 'khyugs pa: dur khrod kyi chas rdzogs pa: bskal pa dus mtha'i

me ltar 'bar ba'i klong nas mtshon cha sna tshogs gdengs shing hūṃ phaṭaḥdang da rgyob kyi sgra 'brug stong dus gcig ldir ba ltar du sgrogs pa dang : mgo brnyan can rnam pa sna tshogs kyis mtshon cha gdengs shing gar byed pa sku jigs pa'i cha lugs dang gsung drag po'i nga ro mthong zhing thos pa'i tshe na 'chi bdag gshin rje'i tshogs rnams dpa' bskungs shing nyam thag par byed pa'i snang ba mched de: de dag thams cad rang gi rdo rje'i phung po'i grong khyer zhi khro sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum du snang ba yin par ngo shes nas gnyis med mnyam pa nyid du 'jog pa'i dbang skal dang ldan na 'og min dur khrod me ri 'bar bar grol ba thob par 'gyur ro: 'od dang thig le zhi ba dang : khro bo'i snang ba de dag thams cad 'od gsal thod rgal chen po'i lam la rab tu goms pa dang sbyang ba thon pa rnams la bsam gtan gyi zhag grangs bdun phrag bdun du 'char te yun ring ba'i stabs kyis ngo shes pa dang grol nga yod de 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i lam gyi sgo ma mthong ba dang : sgo mthong yang dad pa'i nges shes ma skyes pa dang le lo dang rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi rnams kyi dbang du gyur nas nyams su ma lon cing sbyangs pa ma thon pa rnams nam mkha' la sgra gcan dal gyis 'gro ba tsam gyi yun las mi snang bas ngo shes long dang grol long yod pa smos ci dgos: de ltar shar ba'i zhi khro'i snang ba thams cad dbyings su yal tshe sngar gyi thos pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs thams cad dran cing dran ma thag tu brjed du 'gro ba dang thos ma myong zhing rgyus med pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs dpag tu med pa 'char zhing shar ba dang brjed pa dus mnyam du 'byung ba'i gnas skabs la thug ste: gang zag spyi mthun la 'od gdiX ḍi snang ba yun thung zhing gnas skabs 'di'i ngang du cung zad gnas te

la gdul bya rang snang gi ston pa bla mar shar nas grol lam ston cing grol ba thob pa yang yod: rdo rje'i bla ma la dam tshig nyams pa dang : mtshams medakyi las spyod pa rnams ni mar gyi zang thal du 'gro ba ste phyi dbugs chad de nang dbugs ma chad kyi mtshams nas shi dang ma shi'i mtshams mi phyed par bar do med par rdo rje'i dmyal bar ltung ba dang : bla ma dang rdo rje'i mched lcam la dam tshig ma nyams shing khregs chod dang thod rgal la sbyang ba shin tu thon parnams ni yar gyi zang thal du 'gro ba ste phyi dbugs chad de nang dbugs mchad kyi mtshams nas shi dang ma shi'i mtshams mi phyed par bar do med par rangathog tu rang grol ba nam mkha' la nam mkha' thim pa ltar gdod ma gzhi'i chosaskur sangs rgyas pa yin no: de ma gtogs pa thams cad la bar do'i snang ba'adi dag 'byung nges pa yin te: deng sang gi dus skabs nas rgyud lung man ngag gi nang nas bar do'i 'char tshul bstan pa rnams la bltas shing dpyad nas tshul ji lta ba bzhin du shes shing nyams 'og tu chud pa zhig shin tu gal che ba yin pas shes par bya'o: chos nyid bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bar do rdzogasanas: drug pa srid pa las kyi bar do ru kha 'khyol ba'i tshul ni rnam par shesapa las rlung gis bskyod pa'i grol 'khrul gyi dbang gis srid pa rdo rje gdan dang : las kyi dbang gis ma yi mngal gnyis ka la thogs pa'i gnas yin te:de ma gtogs par rdo dang brag dang shing gi khung la sogs pa dngos po thog reg gi gnas thams cad la thogs pa med pa zang thal du rgyu ba dang : rang snang stong pa'i gzugs brnyan sngon gyi sha gzugs ji lta ba bzhin du tshang ba dang bang po'i sgo thams cad tshang zhing yul lnga ji lta ba bzhin du snang zhing rdzu 351

'phrul ya ma zung la dbang 'byor ba dang rang dang rigs mthun pa sna tshogs mthong nas lha yi mig dang ldan te pha rol ba rnams kyi shes rgyud shes te chags sdang gi bsam pa rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung ba yin: re 'ga' mi gral na 'dug kyang mi rnams kyis gtam smra ba go zhing phar smras pa mi go ste lan mi ster ba la thams cad nga la khros 'dug bsam nas zhe snang skye ba dang : gza' mi'i gral du yod kyang rang la bza' btung mi ster ba dang : nyi zla dang me 'od du grib ma mi 'byung ba dang : bye ma dang sa 'bol dang kha ba rnams kyi nang du rkang rjes mi 'byung ba la sogs pa la the tshom nas shi ba yin par shes te 'jigs skrag dang mya ngan dang sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa 'byung ste: bla mchod kyi tshal du skyabs tshol la phyin tshe de dag gis cho ga ma dag pa dang :bskyed rdzogs med pa dang : dam sdom nyams pa la sogs pa'i skyon thams cad mthong ste 'di dag gis nga bslu ba dang ngan song du 'phen 'ong gyin bsam nas log lta skyes te myur du lus zhig e lon snyams te phyogs thams cad du brgyug nas mngal sgo tshol ba bar srid kyi tshe tshad ma rdzogs kyi bar du mngal sgo mi mthong zhing mi rnyed de: zhag bdun re'i mtshams nas sngon gyi 'chi rkyen gyi nad gcod des gdung zhing : skye 'chi'i snang ba re 'char ba'i sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa myong ba dang : ri bo stong rnyil gyi sgra dang : rgya mtsho 'khrugs pa'i sgra dang : me chen 'bar ba'i sgra dang : rlung chen 'ur ba'i sgra sogs 'jigs pa'i sgra bzhi bzod blag med par 'char ba dang : g.yang sa dkar po dang dmar po dang nag po la sogs ba'i dug gsum gyi rang gzugs g.yang sar shar te der lhung ba'i 'jigs skrag bzod blag med pa yang 'char ba dang : dmag dang gshed mas bdas pa dang : ri bos ded

byung ba dang : thog ser drag po steng du 'bab pa la sogs pa'i 'khrul ba'isnang ba bzod med du 'char ba yin no: re 'ga' ni yar phyed snga ma'i lusate mar phyed phyi ma'i lus su snang ba dang : lha dang mi'i gnas gnyis su skye ba'i ltas ni mgo bo lta phyogs gyen du blta ba dang : lha ma yin dang byol songadu skye ba'i ltas su 'phred du blta ba dang : dmyal ba dang yi dwags kyi ltas suthur du blta ba yin no: dmyal bar skye ba'i ltas su 'od nag sdong dum lta budang : yi dwags la bal nag g.yeng ba lta bu dang : byol song la khrag mtsho lta bu dang : mi la 'od dkar po dang : lha la 'od dkar 'dom gang dusnang ba yin te: shes rgyud kyang gzugs med pa'i khams su stong pa la dga' gdung che ba dang : gzugs khams gsal ba la gdung ba: 'dod lha bdeb la gdung ba: mi yul la gdung ba: lha min kha char la gdung ba: duda'agro 'od nag la gdung ba: yi dwags 'od dmar skya la gdung ba: dmyal ba me lce la gdung ba: yul de dag thams cad mdzes shing yid du 'ong b.rasnang nas de la dga' ba dang ga dung ba drag pos blo yid 'gog mi thub pa tsam 'char te: 'di dag gi ngang tshul deng sang gi gnas skabs nas shes par byas te nyams 'og tu chud na da gzod skye ba'i ltas 'di dag ngo shes te chos skugazhi gnas kyi rig pa mngon du byas te der gdeng btsugs nas: gzhi'i 'od gsal ka dag gi chos sku slar yang 'char ba ni yur ba rkang chad pa la wa 'dzug pa lta bu yin te: grol ba thob par 'gyur ro: yang na sngon sbyangs ba'i zhing khams gzhal yas khang yi dam gyi lha dang bcas pa yid la byas te de thog tu sa bzung nas der snang ba 'phros te grol bar 'gyur no: yang na rnam dag dbugs chen 'byin pa'i zhing khams sngon du yid la byas te bag 3/snas

phros te brtan pa thob par 'gyur ro: de ltar sbyong ba'i bag chags med pa ga gis me dpung mdzes pa mthong nas khrod du sleb ma thag tu dmyal ba'i snang ba mched de sdug bsngal ba dang : phug sdug gis nang du phyin pa'i yi dwags snang ba dang : chu bo dang 'dam rdzabs su phyin pa'i dud 'gro'i snang ba mched pa dang : sbrang char dang kha ba bu yug 'tshub pa'i nang du phyin pa'i lha ma yin du snang ba la sogs pa'i skye gnas su zhugs pa tsam gyis snang ba rmi lam sad pa ltar du mched pa yin no: skyed mo'i tshal dang gzhal yas khang la sogs ba snang ste der phyin pa'i lha yi mngal sgo ru zhugs pa yin te snang ba der mched: mi yul 'dzin pa la yang shar lus 'phags po nya zung dang : ba nga spyod ngang ba dang : sgra mi snyan khrung khrung dang : 'dzam bu'i gling pa mi pho mo chags sbyor byed par snang ste de'i dus su mngal gyi sgo bkag na gong gi gnad gsum yid la byas te 'jog pa dang de skar mda' rgyug pa bzhin du 'gro ba'i snang ba yid la byas pas grol ba thob pa yang yod: yang na ni mngal gyi sgo bsdams te gling thams cad kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa 'dzam bu gling du gas dang rus phun sum tshogs pa chos dar ba dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen bzang po'i nye sar mi pho mos sbyor ba byas pa'i tshal du ma la chags shing pha la sdang ba'i sems kyis ma'i gshang lam nas the tshom med par 'jug pa'i tshe rang ma'am yi dam gyi lha ru gsal te 'gro don rgya chen po 'byung bar yid smon da nus na dal 'byor bco brgyad dang ldan pa'i mi lus rin po che thob ngesapa yin no: pha la chags nas ma la sdang ba'i sems kyis zhugs na bu mor skye ba yin pas shes par bya ba gnad du che'o: deng sang gi gnas skabs 'dir 354

bar do'i snang ba'o: zhes zhe thag pa nas yid la 'char bar byas te:'khor 'das stong nyid chen po ru ngo shes pa'i ngang du brdal bar bzhag pa'i yun cig sa bzung zhing gdeng btsugs: slar yang nga ni shi ba dngos red pas snang ba 'di ni bar do'i snang ba srid ba bar do'o: da ni 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi btson dong 'di las thar ba'i thabs zhig bya dgos gyin snyam nas shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams yid la dran par byas te 'od dkar po sprin dpung lta bu zhig shar phyogs kyi dpag tshad grangs med pa'i pha mthar steng gi nam mkha' la mthong snang byas te: zhing khams de ni rgya che zhing khyon yangs pa blo dang yid kyis dpag tu med pa ngos 'jam zhing khod snyoms pa me long gi ngos ltar dwangs shing gsal ba: kha dog sna tshogs pa'i me tog padmos yongs su gang zhing kheb pa mnan na rnam zhing btegs na spar ba phyogasabazhi mtshams brgyad du dpag bsam gyi ljon shing rgyas pa: dag byed bdud rtsi'i chu mig 'bab pa: yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i bdud rtsi'i mtsho dngadzing bu 'khyil ba la rin po che'i gram pa dang g.yu'i ne'u seng dang gser gyi byem brdal ba 'od nam mkha' la 'phags pa phyogs dang 'khor yug thams cad 'ja' tshon gyi drwa mig ris su bris pa las 'dod yon gyi mchod sprin spel ba'i lha mo mang po 'byung ba: sprul pa'i bya tshogs mdzes shing blta na sdug pa yid du 'ong ba skad snyan pa mang pos chos kyi sgra dbyangs glu ru len pa: nam mkha' la 'ja' dang 'od las grub pa'i bla bre dang dar gdugs dang 'phan la sogs pas gzugs snang 'char ba: zhing khams de'i dbus su ye shes kyi da gdangs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang dkar ser dmar ljang mthing

ga'i kha dog rnam par bkra zhing rgya che zhing khyon yangs pa: bkod legs pa rab tu mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba rgyan dang mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs pa'i dbus su: glang po che brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du padma dang nyi zla'i gdan la bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan cing longs spyod rdzogs pa'i chas thams cad sa spras pa ye shes sgyu ma'i sku mchog nyid la 'khor byang chub sems dpa'i gas bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor nas bzhugs pa yid la byas te: zhing khams de ru dpag chen gyis mda' 'phang ba bzhin du song nas gzhal yas khang de la bskor ba lan gsum byas: sdig pa mi dge ba bshags: sgo ba la gsol ba btab pas sgo phyis te nang du zhugs nas de bzhin gshegs pa de la phyag 'tshal: mchod pa 'bul: sdig pa bshags: gsol ba btab:de bzhin gshegs pa de'i thugs brtse ba chen pos dgongs te byin gyis brlabs: lung bstan dbang bskur: chos gsungs ba'i chos gral du 'khod pa dang bcas pa rnams yid la byas te: snang ba gnas 'gyur 'gro ba tsam gyi sbyangs pa thon na srid pa bar do'i skabs su rang shi ba ngo shes ma thag tu sngon sbyangs kyi bag chags de'i stobs kyis 'khor ba las thar 'dod kyi bsam pas zhing khams rjes su dran zhing tshul bzhin yid la byed pa'i shes pa langs te na sbyangs kyi stobs des der 'gro ba'i 'dun pa gtad cing dpag chen gyis mda' bzhin du bsgrod pa dang slob pa'i stobs dang nas pa'i dbang dang skal ba thob nas zhing khams de mched nas der brtan pa thob par 'gyur ro: re ga' ni lha phyogs dpal dang ldan pa'i zhing khams nam mkha' dang bar snang sa /46 thams cad gser gyi kha dog ltar 'bar ba'i dbus na bcom ldan

'das rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu rin chen rigs kyi dba' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i drung du gong ltar bsgrod sleb yid la bya ba dang : re 'ga' ni nub bde ba can gyi zhing khams padma rā ga lta bu'i dbus na snang ba mtha' yas dmar po padma rigs kyi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba nub phyogs kyi dpag tshad grangs med pa'i pha mthar yid la byas te bsgrod pa dang sleb pa la sogs pa gongabazhin du yid la byas te sbyangs pa thon par bya ba dang : de 'ga' ni byang phyogs kyi dpag tshad grangs med pa'i pha mthar las rab rdzogs pa'i zhing khams ind+ra ni la'i kha dog lta bu'i dbus su bcom ldan 'das don yod grub pa longs spyod rdzogs sku'i chas kyis brgyan pa la: 'khor kurma rigs kyi dpa' po dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba zhing khams kyi bkod pa gong ltaramangon sum mig gis mthong ba lta bu zhig yid la byas te der dpag chen gyis mda' bzhin du bsgrod pa dang : nyes can btson nas thar te rang yul la sleb pa bzhin du thon te de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag mchod gsol ba 'debs pa sogs gong bzhin yid la bya ba dang : skabs 'gar snang ba thams cad yi dam lha'i zhing khams su gsal te dper na yul yangs pa'i dbus nas shar lho nub byang gi sa cha mig gis mthong ba bzhin du shar phyogs kyi zhing khams me tog dkar pos brgyan pa 'od dkar po nam mkha' la 'phags pa dang : lho phyogs na dpal dang ldan pa'i zhing khams me tog ser pos brgyan pa 'od ser po nam mkha' la 'phags pa: nub bde ba can gyi zhing khams me tog dmar sa brgyan pa 'od dmar po nam mkha' la 'phags pa: byang phyogs na las ba rdzogs pa'i zhing khams me tog ljang gus brgyan cing 'od ljang nam shāka'

de'i ngang du gdeng btsugs nas 'dug cing : res 'ga' ni dpag chen gyis mda' 'phang ba bzhin du zhing khams de dag tu bsgrod pa dang sleb pa'i snang ba sbyang ba ni bar do dbugs chen por 'byin pa'i stobs nus rgyud la 'jog pa yin pas gdams pa 'di la sbyangs ba thon cing rgyud la brtan pa thob pa zhig gnad mchog tu bzung bar bya'o: chos nyid bar do'i dus su bla ma'am mched grogs dam tshig la sel med ba zhig gis 'di skad brjod:kyai: rigs kyi bu che ge mo zhes ming nas lan gsum drangs te: ma dag pa 'khor ba'i sgo dag pa chos nyid du thim pas ston nam slong byed kyi skyon gsum dang bral ba'i gnas skabs lta bu khyab brngal phyogs mtha' dang bral pa dwangs gsal rnyog pa med pa zhig 'char ba de ni khyod rang gi gdod ma'i ye gzhi ka dag gi ngo bo yin pas ngo shes par gyis shig: shes thog tu gdeng tshugs shig: gdeng thog tu sa zungs shig dang ca chos sku kun tu bzang po'i dgongs pa phyin ci ma log pa'i dbyings su sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro: ces lan gsum gdab: de zhag gsum re la lan grangs gsum re brjod:gsum pa nas bdun pa tshun chad du: kye: rigs kyi bu che ge mo khyod rabatu nyon la yid la zungs shig dang : 'od dang zer dang thig le dang sku zhi ba dang khro bo'i snang ba 'char ba de rnams ni: ka dag lhun grub tu thim pa zhesabya ba yin te: 'byung ba'i snyigs ma dwangs mar mched pas 'od lnga dwangs mabacud du smin pa'i thig le bcud 'bras bur smin pas sku ru snang ba yin te shes pa gzhan du ma yengs par ma pang du bu 'jug pa lta bur snang ba 'od dngabasres shig: sems sku dang thig le ru bsres shig: rang snang 'od gsal

bde ba chen por rang bzhin mngon du gyur pa yin pas ngo shes par gyis sheg:der bsres shing 'phos te gdeng tshugs par gyis shig: gdeng thog tu sa zungs la gzhan du ma yengs ma 'khrul bar sa zin na khyod bar do longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro: rang snang khro bo'i dkyil 'khor la ma skrag rang sgra rang la snang ba la ma 'jigs sna tshogs snang ba'i zer la ma sngangs bar gzhi'i rig pa 'khor 'das 'ub chub kyi rol pa ru dang brtan cing 'byams klas par gyis shig: ces gdab bo: bdun zhag drug la'ang rang gi mdun du rten btsugs pa la 'gugs gzhug lan dgu ru bskyar nas 'od kyi ga'ur tshud par bsam te: kyi: rigs kyi bu che ge mo khyod ma yongs par nyon cig: khyod nges par shi ba yin pas ngo shes par gyis shig: khyod la srid pa bar do'i snang ba gar bsam pa der skad cig gis sleb pa dang :'khrul snang 'jigs skrag gi snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa shar 'dug pa de srid pa las kyi bar do zhes bya ba yin gyis: 'khor 'das kyi sa mtshams la thug pa red pas 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin bde ba'i gnas skabs tila'abru tsam yang med pa 'di la skyo zhing sun par gyis la lha dang mi sogs gnas rigs drug gi 'jig rten 'di dag 'khrul snang sgyu ma dang rmi lam gyi gnas yul lta bu yin te: zhen pa dang chags pa btsan thabs su chod la 'di nas shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten mngon par dga' ba zhes bya ba dga' bde dang yon tan dpag tu med pas brgyan pa'i zhing khams zhig yod kyis de na bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bya bas byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor tshogs dpag tu med pa la chos ston cing byin gyis brlabs pa yod de: de yid la gyis shig: khyod la gdos bcas sha khrag gi phung po ni med: stong gzugs 35

songs shig: ces phaṭaḥbarjod pas skar mda' bzhin du song bar bsam:yang phaṭaḥbarjod pas zhing der sleb par bsam: yang phaṭaḥbarjod pas zhing khams gyi snang ba mched ngo shes gdeng thob rtsal rdzogs brtan pa thob par bsam: yang gong bzhin kha bsgyur: 'di nas lho phyogs su dpal dang ldan pa'i zhing khams zhes bya ba bde skyid yon tan gyi dpal phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa na bcom ldan 'das rin chen 'byung ldan zhes bya bas 'khor byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa la chos ston cing byin gyis sogs:'di nas nub phyogs kyi dpag tshad grangs med pa'i pha mthar bde ba can gyi zhing khams zhes bya ba bde skyid dpag tu med pa'i dbyings na bcom ldan 'das snang ba mtha' yas 'od dpag tu med pa zhes bya bas 'khor sogs:yang 'di nas byang phyogs kyi 'jig rten grangs med pa'i pha mtha' na las rab rdzogs pa'i zhing khams zhes bya ba sku dang ye shes kyi bkod pa rab tu rdzogs pa'i dbyings na bcom ldan 'das don yod grub pa zhes bya bas 'khor byangachub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa la chos ston cing byin gyib rlabs payod de: de yid la gyis shig: khyod la gdos bcas sha khrag gi phung po nimed: stong gzugs yid kyi lus de byang phyogs kyi zhing khams der dpag chen gyis mda' bzhin du songs shig: ces phaṭaḥbarjod pas skar mda'abazhin du song bar bsam: yang phaṭaḥbarjod pas zhing khams der sleb parabasam: yang phaṭaḥbardzod pas zhing khams kyi snang ba mched ngo shes gdengathob rtsal rdzogs brtan pa thob par bsam: ces bskyed rdzogs la gomasa'adris cung zad yod pa ma gtogs ngo sprod kyi phan thog pa shin tu dka' ste:360

bskyed rdzogs la goms 'dris cung zad yod pa'i skyes bu la ngo sprod 'di dag thebs na mi 'jigs pa'i dbugs chen po 'byin par 'gyur ba yin no:'dren pa po lta dgongs dang ldan na mched pa nyer thob la thim pas gnas skabs su kho'i rnam par shes pa āḥyig dkar po dri ma med pa gsal la 'tsher ba zhig tu bsgom la ming nas lan gsum bos te: kye: rigs kyi bu che ge mo khyod kyi rnam par shes pa āḥyig dkar po dri ma med pa zhig tu sgoms shig:ces lan gsum gdab: kyi: rigs kyi bu khyod rang gi spyi bor tshangs pa'i bu ga rgya skar lta bu de nyid du yar gyi zang thal du 'gro ba'i 'a ma yin te der skar mda' rgyug pa bzhin du 'phos shig: ces brjod de: 'dren pa po rang gi rig pa dang pha rol po'i rnam par shes pa gnyis med du bsres te yun gcig mnyam par bzhag ste skar mda' rgyug pa bzhin du tshangs pa'i bu ga nas thon cing stong phyogs 'og min gyi gnas su thim par bsam la āḥlnga tshar brjod padang chab gcig tu phaṭaḥsgra gsum gyis spar: 'dren pa po ye shes yon tan gyi dpal dang ldan na pha rol po'i tshang bug tu rlangs pa phyu ru ru 'ong na thebs pa'i rtags yin te: de ltar ma byung na rang gi snying ga nas 'od dang 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros te sku gsum rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor thams cad 'od phung kha dog lnga ldan gyi rnam par mer gyis zhu nas thibs kyis 'dus te tshe 'das de'i spyi bor gru gang tsam gyi steng gi nam mkhar sangs rgyas 'od dpag tu med pa mekhor byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa gsal zhing de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs kur padma dang zla ba'i gdan la chos sku kun tu bzang po che chung mtho gang ba gcer bu gos rgyan med pa zhig gi thugs por baḥyig dkar po zla ba ltar gsal ba gcig bsgom: de dag gi sku ladī /da

gsum la zhugs pas sems dang snang ba thams cad 'od du zhig nas lus 'od lus stong ra'i gur khyim du gyur pa'i dbus su 'od phung de dag gis tshe 'das kyi bla yid sems gsum dang bcas pa bsdus te byin rlabs 'od kyi sbu gu khang stong du ka ba btsugs pa lta bu: yar sna kun tu bzang po'i thugs ga'i āḥl zug pa mar sna snying gar zug cing 'gag pa: de'i nang du spyi bor man chad ngag yan chad kyi bar du āḥdakar po nyi shu rtsa gcig brtsegs mar gnas pa: tshe 'das kyi bla yid sems gsum gyi ngo bor bsam te āḥphaṭaḥnyi shu rtsa gcig bsgrags pas rim pa bzhin du lugs su ldog ste āḥthog ma la thim de nyid nam mkha'i skar mda' bzhin du: kun tu bzang po'i thugs kwa'i āḥl bstim te phaṭaḥgacig brjod pas bde ba can gyi zhing khams ji lta ba bzhin du mched par bsam: gnyis brjod pas ngo shes par byas: gsum brjod pas rtsal rdzogs shing brtan pa thob par bsam la: zhing khams de da la byas nas ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag pa 'di mchog dman kun la sbyar kyang gnad zab la chod che ba yin no: 'dren pa po bskyed rim gyi gnad shes shing goms 'dris med na ji ltar byas kyang tha mal gyi smon lam btabapa tsam las phan skyob kyi nus pa zad do: de'i phyir 'dren ston rnams kyis lta sgom gyi gdeng dang ldan par bya ba dang : gzhan don sgrub pa la bskyed rim nga 'pho ba'i gnad la bslab nas sbyangs pa thon pa re ma byas na: chon jag na gnyer la chas te don thob pa tsam du gyur nas gzhan mgo bskor bas rang ching ba ni srin bu'i kha chus de nyid 'ching ba lta bur 'gyur te: rang nyid ngan song gi sdug bsngal myong bar byed pa'i rgyu rin gyis nyo ba yin te de'i ngang

tshul shes dgos so: rgyud kyi yang snying gzhi rgyud bde gshegs snying po'i klong mdzod ka dag gzhon nu bum sku'i ye shes kyi sgo du mar snang tshul dang chos nyid rang gi ngang du rang grol bar byed pa'i thabs dang : shes rab kyi sgo tshul bzhin du bstan pa 'di ni gdod ma gzhi'i ston pa mcho skyes rdo rje bdag las mi gzhan pa rol ba'i 'khor tshogs rnams la bstan pa'i dgos ched ni:sngon 'byung gi dus su rdzogs pa chen po'i bstan pa nyi ma ltar shar te las dang skal bar ldan pa'i skyes bu rnams la ston mchog dam pa rnams kyis 'chad pa'i tshe na: dang po lta bas thag bcad bar du bsgom pas ngo spyod cing skyon bsal tha ma spyod pa byar med du gnas shing nyams su blangs pas grub thob sha stag 'byung pa dang ca rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i rtags ma tshang ba med pa mngon du gyur pa ni zab lam rdo rje snying po'i khyad chos bla na med pa yin te: deng sang gi dus na lta ba la nyams rgyus med par shes pa rang gsal tsam ngo sprad de ji ltar bsgoms kyang tha mal las mi 'phags shing rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas kyi 'bras bu la thob dus med pa de ga yin pa dang : slob dpon 'ga' zhig kha bshad la mkhas kyang rnam par grol ba'i lam ston mi nus pas gzhan rgyud la phan thog pa yang de tsam las mi srid do: de ltar rim pa bzhin du 'chad pa'i slob dpon dkon pa dang nyams len gyi skyes bu med pa'i stobs kyis rdzogs pa chen po'i bstan pa ri mo'i mar me ltar song ba la phang nas dus skabs 'di ga tsam du ston pa dang bstan pa 'dzom pa'i rten 'brel 'grigs pa'i phyir bstan pa yin te 'di yang sprin bar gyi nyi zhur tsam las yun du gnas par 'gyur ba ni ma yin: de ci'i phyir zhe na:'chad mkhan gyi slob dpon med pa dang las smon skal bar ldan pa'i skyes bu

dkon pa'i phyir dbyings las byung cing dbyings su sdud pa yin no: ces gsungs pa la rig pa'i rdo rje la sogs pa'i 'khor 'dus pa thams cad yi rang ste mngon par bstod do: de ma thag tu ston pa mtsho skyes rdo rje 'od phung du dengs nas 'khor rnams kyang 'od de ru dengs nas 'od cher mched de snang ba thams cad khyab bo: snang ba thams cad 'od du dengs nas 'od nam mkha' dang 'dres: nam mkha' khyab brdal du 'byams klas so: yul med stong pa'i dbyings nas sgra 'di skad byung snang : mya: 'od gsal rdo rje snying po bsgom pa'i skyes bu rnams nyon cig: rtogs pas bdag grol: thugs rjes gzhan grol: gnyis med dag mnyam gyi rol par sangs rgyas pa'i tshul ni de lta bu zhig yin no: zhu hūṃ :: khams gsum gyi dbang phyug ma hā de wa de'i sras mchog mgon po yongs kyi sprul gzhi tshogs kyi bdag po: 'khor 'das stong chen du rol pa'i dbyings kyi rje mo: khams gsum dbang sdud kyi rgyal po gnod sbyin shan pa dmar nag: snang srid yongs khyab kyi bdag po gza' bdud dug gi spu gri: 'byung ba byed po rgyal btsan drag shul dpal 'bar dang bcas pa rnams la dus gsum rgyal ba yongs kyi srog gi yang thig dam pa mdo sngags rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i yang snying bcud du dril ba'i rgyud kyi yang snying gnas lugs rang byung gi rgyud chen po 'di nyid bkas gtad do: dam tshig gis gnyer ro: snod ldan skyes bu dam pa rnams la sprod la thar pa dang rnam mkhyen gyi sa la sbyor ba'i byed po gyis shig: snod med log par lta ba'i rigasarnams la gsang rgyar thob cig: sgro btags bskur 'debs byed pa'i bstanadagra rnams kyi dbang po snubs la dus mtha' bstungs shig: 'dzin skyong spelagasnam byed pa'i skyes bu rnams kyi sku tshe bsring la mthun rkyen dang grogs

༵༵ traṃ (sdo bye spra pyir py-i pyis dṛ /sdo py-i /byedapa ci byib spe ༷dab ṭā rdo / dīkā dīhā/ cig: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: gtad rgya: zab rgya: 3ni: ces pa 'di mi lo bco brgyad bar du bka' rgya byas mthar rten 'brel dus la bab pa'i tshe slob bu tshes bcu dang : hor gyi bla ma phun tshogs bkra shis lha rje rig 'dzin bzang po rnams kyis bskul ba don yod pa'i phyir khrag 'thung bdud 'joms rdo rjes 'od gsal sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i dbyings las bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni hor gyi bla ma phun tshogs bkra shis dang 'go log (mgo log)phyogs kyi lha rje rig 'dzin bzang po gnyis kyis bgyis pa'o: dkon mchog rin chen gsum gyi bden pa dang gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i mthu byin gyis: 'di mthong tshul bzhin nyams su len pa yi: rgyud 'dzin skal ldan pho mo ma lus pa: chos sku gdodama'i mgon po'i 'od klong du: gzhon nu bum skur yang dag sangs rgyas shog: dge'o: dge'o: dge'o: sarba maṅgā lo: dza yantu:365

dang 'brel ba'i gnas lugs rang byung rgyud kyi bsdus don gsal bshad zla ba'i 'od snang zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs pad ma 'byung / /gang gi gsang gsum sgyu 'phrul bdud 'joms gling / /ris med bstan 'gro'i spyi dpal 'jigs med rjer/ /gus pas 'dud do dge legs snang ba stsol/ /zhes tshigs su bcad pas mdun bsus te rmad byung yab rje bla ma'i gdung rabs nyung tsam brjod na/ de yang bdag cag gi ston pa thabs mkhas thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa de nyid kyis ma 'ongs pa na rgyal bstan byang nas byang du dar bar lung bstan pa bzhin du rab brjid gangs kyi ri bos yongs su mdzes pa'i byang phyogs bsil ldan kha ba can gyi zhing khams 'dir rgyal po lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan gyi ring la dam pa'i chos kyi dbu brnyes/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos srol btod/ mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan gyi sku nga la sngon gyi smon lam chen po'i mthus mkhan slob chos gsum sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzin par ngang gis zhal 'dzoms te mdo sngags kyi bstan pa rin po

che sgo kun nas dar zhing rgyas par btang ba'i bka' drin la brten nas/ khyad chos drug gis khyad du 'phags pa'i snga 'gyur gsang sngags rnying ma zhes yongs su grags pa'i bstan pa rin po che 'dzin skyong spel gsum mdzad pa'i sprul ba'i gter ston brgya rtsa dang mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi skyes bu dam pa mang po/gter phran stong rtsa sogs byon pa las/ 'dir chos sku'i ston pa rdo rje 'chang chen pos bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong gi bstan pa ma rdzogs kyi bar du/nga yi sprul pa rgyun mi chad par 'byung nas gang la gang 'dul gyis 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po byed par shog cig ces smon lam btab pa bzhin du rnam 'dren bzhi pa shākya thub pa'i dus su shes rab mchog gyur nyan thos shā ra'i bu dang /de'i 'og tu hūm̐ chen ka ra/ khye'u chung lo tsā ba/ gaḥthog dam pa bde gshegs/grum gyi mkhar nag he pa chos 'byung / snga ma rig 'dzin bdud 'dul rdo rje/phyi ma bdud 'dul rol pa rtsal gyis gra dkar nag gi bdud tshogs mang po chos la btsud de shing pho spre'u'i lo la rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i bsu ma dang bcas te rnga yab padma 'od du gshegs/ de nas slob dpon chen pos bdud 'dul rol pa rtsal la gdul bya'i tshad dang 'byung 'gyur gyi lung bstan sogs gsungs nas gdul byed phrin las kyi byed po ru gzugs skur bzhengs shig ces bkas bskul ba mdzad pa ma bzlog par slar yang skye 'gro mi yi dpal du byon pa ni/da rus chen drug gi ya gyal du gyur pa'i a lcags 'bru yi rigs rus su sprul bsgyur bzung tshul ni/ sngon gyi dus su 'bru sngon po'i myu gu gnubs yul du nga ba de las/ grub pa'i rgyal po gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes dang /sangs rgyas gnyis pa padma saṃ bha wa'i thugs sras nam mkha'i snying po sogs kyis nga du mi yi srid pa bzung ba'i rigs la gnubs kyi rigs zhes bya'o/ 3/ 7

de nas yul dus kyi rkyen las rim gyis yul brgyud nas khams kyi shar gas mtsho khri shor rgyal mo dang nye ba'i rma khog tu gnas bcas pa la rong tha zhes grags/ phyis de yang gnas spar te khams phyogs kyi gnas chen nyer lnga'i ya rgyal/ shar mi nyag ra ba sgang gi sa'i thig le/ sprang mi pham mgon pos he ru ga'i sgrub gnas su byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas chen sba zhabs brag dkar gyi g.yas phyogs su/ 'dra lcags khung khog tu gnubs rigs byung ba la lcags khung pa zhes yongs su grags so/ / der gnas pa'i gnubs rigs che 'bring chung gsum gyi brgyud pa las grub brnyes thar ba rgyal mtshan sogs byon/ yang chung brgyud las lcags khung skyong lo dang gdugs dkar gnyis kyis rdo gser phyogs su gnas bcas/ gdugs dkar la sras gsum las/ che ba dpal grags/ 'bring ba mgon skyabs/ chung ba dar rgyas bcas 'khrungs/ 'bring ba mgon skyabs kyi sras su lcags khung a bstan 'khrungs/ de la sras gnyis yod pa las chung ba ni o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i zhal skyin khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po rig 'dzin grub pa'i dbang phyug ma dang mkha' 'gro yongs kyi tshogs dpon gter chen khrag 'thung bdud 'joms rdo rje nyid yab lcags khung a bstan dang yum dmu tsha sga yi rus su gtogs pa bo rdzogs gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i shing mo lug gi lor dge mtshan legs pa'i ltas sna tshogs bcas pa'i ngang nas sku bltams/ dam pa 'di nyid 'khrungs dus nas lha dang bla ma mkha' 'gros bu sdug bzhin du bskyangs nas grub pa'i go 'phang mthon po brnyes pa dang / mi dang mi min gyi yul nas zab gter bzhes te bstan 'gro'i rgud pa bsal ba/ chos nyid nam mkha'i klong mdzod sogasdu zab chos la mnga' dbang bsgyur ba dang / skal ba dang ldan pa'i gang

du ma dang / rigs sras su sems dpa' brgyad kyi rnam sprul nye ba'i sras chen brgyad byon pa sogs rnam thar brjod kyi mi langs kyang / sngar deb dang po'i nang du cung zad bshad pas 'dir bzlos skyon du dogs nas ma bkod do/ /nye sras brgyad las che ba mkhas btsun grub pa'i dbang phyug gnas lnga rig pa'i gter mdzod 'phags mchog phyag na padmo mi yi sha tshugs su rol ba rdo grub rin po che sku phreng gsum pa 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi ma mchog ni/yab khrag 'thung bdud 'joms rdo rje dang yum ḍā ki ma khra bza' bsod nams mcho gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i shing glang lor ngo mtshar gyi rtags du ma dang bcas sku 'khrungs/ yab kyis mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan bzhin kun bzang 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi ma phrin las kun khyab dpal bzang po zhes mtshan gyi co pan gnang / khong gis yi ge 'bri klog sogs la sbyangs pa cher brtson ma dgos par bde legs su mkhyen/ rdzogs chen rin po che mi 'gyur nam mkha'i rdo rjes rdo grub kyi sprul sku ngos bzung nas dgung lo drug par yar lung padma bkod du khri la mnga' gsol/ rig 'dzin grub pa'i dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang po dang / 'ju mi pham phyogs las rnam rgyal/mkhas grub padma badzra/ dzra mu ra sprul sku/ zhe chen 'gyur med mthu stobs rnam rgyal/ kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma bsten nas mdo sngags rig gzhung dang bcas par thos bsam sbyang ba rgya cher byas nas mkhas pa'i khri la mnga' dbang bsgyur/ khyad par du sa dge bka' rnying sa su ma chad pa'i sgrub brgyud shing rta brgyad kyi zab chos kyi dbang lung man ga du ma mnos nas mkhyen dpyod rtogs pa'i shes rab rab tu rgyas/ dgung

bka' bzhin 'tshogs mang la spyod 'jug thugs thog nas rgyas par 'chad tshe der 'dus skye bo mang po ngo mtshar ba'i gnas su gyur/ dpal sprul rin po ches rdo grub byis pa 'dis spyod 'jug blo thog nas 'chad tshul la/ lung gi bstan pa'i gnas tshad da dung rdzogs mi 'dug ces thugs dgyes tshor chen po mdzad/ skabs shig yab gter chen bla ma dang chos kyi bgro gling nyin zhag brgyad du byas mthar/ yab kyis kho bo ni chos nyid kyi klong rdol ba yin pas chos kyi mtha' la zad pa med/ khyod bslab tshig 'jug med zhig la mkhas po red ces bsngags brjod gnang / gzhan yang / gnod sbyin tsi'u dmar po sogs snying thig gi bstan srung rnams lus dang grib ma bzhin 'bral med du 'grogs nas gang bcol gyis phrin las sgrub pa dang 'ja' dang 'od thig gi klong nas ye shes mkha' 'gros mchod g.yog byed pa sogs dam pa'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ / khong sku tshe gang bor ris med kyi bstan pa spyi dang khyad par gsang ba snying po'i bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum rgya cher byas pa dang gang la gang 'dul gyis 'gro ba rnams la phan bde'i dbugs dbyung mdzad de mthar rab byung bco lnga'i me stag lor 'ja' 'od me tog gi char gyis nam mkha'i khyon yongs su bkang ste gzugs sku'i bkod pa 'od gsal chos sku'i dbyings su gzims so/ /khong gi slob ma'i gtso bo ni/ rdo grub mkhan chen rnam bzhi dang thugs sras dri med 'od zer/ rdzong gsar mkhyen brtse 'jam dbyangs chos kyi gros/ gter chen las rab gling pa/ shug chung sprul sku tshul khrims bzang po/ sman rtsis stag bla nor bu sogs slob tshogs bgrang las 'das pa byung

mdzod kyi lde mig dang / las 'phro gter brgyud kyi rnam gzhag ngo mtshar rgya mtsho/ da sngon ljongs 'dir ma grags pa'i bstan bcos khyad 'phags gzungs kyi rnam bshad sogs pod bcu phrag gdul bya'i dpal du rnam par bzhugs so/ /o rgyan mtsho skyes rdo rje dang gnyis su ma mchis pa klong chen rdo rje gzi brjid padma las 'brel rtsal lam thugs sras dri med 'od zer mchog ni/sangs rgyas gling pa'i tsi dmar yang byang las/ shar padma rdo rje khro lod 'byung / / rigs kyi myu gu rasmi ming / / dgongs 'dus skor gsum chos la dbang / / nga yi bstan pa de yis 'dzin/ / zhes dang / ratna gling pa'i thugs sgrubakha byang las/ nga min nga yi thugs kyi sras/ / sbrul lo rasmi'i ming can 'byung / / thugs sgrub rnam gsum chos sgo 'byed/ / ces sogs sngon byon dam pa rnams kyis rdo rje'i lung gis bsngags pa/ don la khyab bdag gdod ma'i mgon po dang dbyer ma mchis pa gter chen 'di nyid ston pa'i spyar sngar dge slong kun dga' bo/ grub pa'i dbang phyug dharma kṣi/ rgya gar mkhan po bi ma mi tra/ kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams/ 'gro mgon padma gling pa/ཿthog klong gsal snying po/ rgya nag mkhan po shākya de wa sogs kyi sku skyes bzhes te bstan dang 'gro la phan pa bzang po'i legs tshogs bskrun/ slar yang gdul bya 'gro ba'i khams la gang 'dul ye shes sgyu ma'i skur bzhengs tshul / bod rab byung bcu bzhi pa lcags sbrul sa ga zla ba'i yar tshes bzang po la ba gter khrag 'thung bdud 'joms gling pa dang yum ḍā ki ske bza' sangs sa mtsho gnyis kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ zla ba gsum tsam nas ye shes mkha' 371

slebs skabs skad dang yig rigs mi 'dra ba mang po thugs la shar yang btang mas su bzhag me khyi lor sku mched che ba rdo grub bstan pa'i nyi mas yab la rtsang chen dgon du bdag gcig pu yin pas spun 'di bdag la gnang rogs zhes zhu ba phul bas gnang nas dgung lo drug gi steng rdo grub chen dgon du phebs/ de nas rdo grub rin po che bla mar bsten nas rdzogs chen sngon 'gro na bzang bla ma'i zhal lung dang dngos gzhi khregs chod thod rgal gyi nyams na sogs la sbyang ba mthar chags su mdzad pa dang / gzhan gsar rnying ris med kyi gzhung lugs mang po thugs nyams su bzhes/ dgung lo brgyad par sngon sbyangs dge ba'i bag chags sad nas mi min mkha' 'gro rnams kyis lung bstan dang o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pas zhal gzigs gnang ba sogs rin po che la zhus tshe/ rin po ches spyir bdag gis khyod ngur smrig gi bstan pa phan par re'ang / da bstan pa la gang la phan thogs na khyad med pas/ yab gter chen bla ma'i bka' bzhin sgrub dang bstan 'gro la phan pa'i tshad ldan gyi sa bu zhig 'ong thang gsungs/ de nas skye ba tshe rabs kyi bla ma yab gter chen chos kyi rgyal po nyid la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes bcos min sems kyi nga nas rnyed de thugs mnyes pa gsum gyis brten nas gter kha snga phyi kun gyi bang khrid phyag bzhes rnams legs par gsan/ skabs sheg mtshan ldan bla mchog gis da lan khyod la spros med don gyi gsang dbang dri chu bdud rtsi'i rgyun la bsten nas bskur dgos gsungs nas skra dbang yongs rdzogs skur skabs/ rang lus 'phar ba dang g.yo ba/ gnas khang phyi nang kun tu bzang 'thul ba/ gling bu rol mo'i sgra rang byung du grags pa sogs ngo 72

mtshar ba'i rtags du ma byung / de yang ral ba ma bcos lcang lo ldan pasagang snang ye shes grogs su shar ba/ na bza' ma bcos gos dkar gyon pasanyon mongs skyon gyi dri ma bral ba/ sems nyid ma bcos gzhug mar bzhag pasaskugasum mnyam nyid dbyings su chub pa/ rgyan cha ma bcos rus rgyan gsol bas/ lnga ldan zhing la mnga' dbang bsgyur ba bcas ma bcos bzhi ldan gyi rnal 'byor dam par gyur to/ / dgung lo bcu dgu la son tshe yab rje bla ma'i gter gsar gyi rtsa gsum chos skyong dang bcas pa'i mtshams la dam rgyar nyin zhag bdun du bzhugs nas dngos grub len skabs dkyil 'khor nang du gtor ma bdud rtsir zhu ba dang /snye mkha' nas me tog gi char babs pa sogs rtags khyad 'phags mang po byung / khyad par du yi dam lha'i zhal mngon sum du gzigs shing lung bstan dbugs dbyung mdzad/ dgung lo nyer gsum chu yos lor yab rje gter chen bla mas gdul bya'i mdzad pa re zhig rdzogs pa'i tshul gyis rnga yab padma 'od du sku gshegs khar gter rdzas kun gyi zhing bcud o rgyan za hor ma dang / g.yang thod/ sku chas/ gter sgrom du ma bcas zab chos yongs rdzogs kyi dbang lung gab sbas med par gces nor gyi tshul du gnang nas pha rjes bu yis zin par gyis shig ces sras kyi thu bor mnga' gsolagazhan yang dag pa'i gzigs snang la o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa dang mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal/ rig 'dzin ku ma rā dza/ paṇa chen bi ma mi tra rnams kyis zhal gzigs lung bstan gdams ngag dus bzhin du gnang bas gsang ba zab mo'i dri char rdol/ khong gi gter gnas gser smad rnga la stag rtse/ brag dkar sprel rdzong / gangs ri thod dkar/ rdza rgyal 'phan phyug rma na sbom ra sogs su phebs te gter srung dpa' bo mkha' 'gros gter gyi kha 373

phar phyes/ skabs shig rig pa'i nyams sangs pa'i rkyen las ri brag la zang thal du bsgrod/ dbus phyogs su phebs skabs bka' blon lha klus/ rje nyid dan drangs nas blon 'bangs rnams la klong chen snying thig gi chos skor dang ba rje bla ma'i zab gter gyi dbang lung gang mtshams su gnang bas bod sde ba zhung gi dbu bla ru bkur te mdzad 'phrin phyogs bcur rgyas/ dgung grangs so gsum lor nyag bla gter chen las rab gling pa stag thog gong mar gdul bya khyon pa dang 'jal 'phrad mdzad tshe/ yab gter chen bla ma'i gsung chos rdzogs chen ma bsgom sangs rgyas kyi khrid gzhung la rtsod gzhi byas nas nyin zhag 'gar bcod pas/ las gling gi zhal nas lta sgom spyod 'bras kyi 'jog mtshams sam gnad 'gag ci 'dra yin dris pas/rje'i zhal nas bdag gi yab ma'i dgongs pa zur tsam lon pa dka' yang / lta ba skye med du thag chodam pa yengs med du rgyun skyong / spyod pa 'gags med du rtsal sbyong / 'bras ba blo 'dus su la bzla ba dka' gnad kyi chings su bstan pa yin gsungs pasagater chen nyid thugs shin tu dgyes shing pha rjes bus non zer ba 'di ltar na/ da khyod kyi bla ma'i lta ba 'di ma red zer na kun mkhyen yab sras kyi sungs kyang min par khas len dgos so gsungs nas bsngags brjod rgya ra gnang / gzhan yang gnas yul rnams su byon nas gter kha du ma spyan drangs pa dang / rtsa ba/ yal ga/ sdong po/ 'bras bu'i zab gter pod bcu ga lhag chos bdag grogs kyi rten 'brel 'dzoms pa'i dus bab dang bstun nas gtan phab 'grems spel mdzad pa sogs rnam thar brjod mtha' yas pa da kyang / rgyal yum ye shes mcho rgyal gyi gsung sprul kun bzang bde ba'i rdo 374

rje'am dbus bza' mkha' 'gro ma'i gsungs pa gter chen 'di nyid kyi rnam thar ratna'i chun 'phyang utpala'i phreng bar gsal bas 'dir de tsam mo/ /de ltar snyigs khams mun pa'i khrod du zab gter chos kyi sgron me gdul bya 'gro ba'i dpal du rgya cher spel nas mthar bod rab byung bco lnga pa'i shing phoḥ ba'i lo'i sa ga zla ba'i tshes bcu'i nyin/ shar phyogs lhun po'i rtse nas rab gsal nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lham mer 'dzum ma thag gter chen mchog gis spyan gnyis nam mkha'i mthongs su gzigs/ phyag gnyis ḍā ki bde ba'i rdo rje'i dbu thog tu bzhag nas/ a haṃ/ bdag ni thabs mchog bde chen he ru ka/ / khyod ni stong dbyings shes rab yum chen mo/ / zung 'jug gnyis med spyod pa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ / snang grags rigs gsum dag pa rab 'byams zhing / / sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa'i klong / / zung 'jug mi shigs rta phag yab yum skur/ / rab sad gzhon nu bum skur sangs rgyas shog/ ces gsungs nas gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings su bsdus te nang gsal gzhon nu bum sku ru sangs rgyas so/ /chos bdag slob ma'i skor la/ zab chos yongs rdzogs kyi bdag po bso sprul sna tshogs rang grol/ gsang bdag dngos snang gter sras rdo rje dgra 'dul/ rdzong gter kun bzang nyi ma/ ḍā ki bde ba'i rdo rje/ sgo sprul chos kyi blo gros/ a skyabs bla ma kurma don grub/ bi ma'i rnam rol bstan 'dzin dar rgyas sogs dam pa'i bu slob bgrang gis mi langs pa mang po byon nas bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don chen mdzad do / /de yang lung las/ gdul bya yi 'gro don smos ci dgos/ / gdung rgyud nga 'gro mgon dpal 'bar ba/ / nyi zla bzhin bstan 'gro'i mun pa 7

seng bzhur bzhur byed/ / co brgyad nas rig 'dzin gral thag bsdu/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ lcags khung a bstan gyi sras che ba/ khrag 'thung bdud joms rdo rje'i sku mched/ lugs gnyis kyi yon tan dang ldan pa lcags khung chos rgyas la 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po dang slob dpon g.yu sgra snying po zung rnam 'phrul lcags khung gnas mchog 'khrungs/ de ni mkha' 'gro'i gsang gtam las/ g.yu sgra khyod kyi tsha bor sprul/ / khyod kyi gdung rgyud ma stong bar/ / rig 'dzin dam pa'i rgyun mi 'chad/ / zhes gsungs pa de yin/de'isras rigs kyi gdung 'dzin lcags khung pad te zhes bya ba la deng snyigs dus bstan pa'i gsal byed du mnyam med thub pa'i dbang pos lung gis bstan pa/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi thugs kyi 'od zer gyis blo gros kyi padmo kha phyes te shes bya'i chos la sgrib med du gzigs pa/ o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i rgyal tshab/ mkhas btsun grub pa'i dbang phyug rigs dang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag bka' drin mtshungs med 7chos rje dam pa yid bzhin nor bu 'jigs med phun tshogs 'byung gnas dpal bzang po mchog ni/ sngon bdag cag gi ston pa'i dus su ma ma skye dgu'i bdag mo/ o rgyan yul du chos blon trika na 'dzin pa/ bod du sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i spyan sngar sngags 'chang rdo rje bdud 'joms/ sa skya paṇa chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ rje mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang / mi nyag kun bzang chos grags/ gter chen las rab gling pa sogs dam pa mang po'i sku skye bzhes nas ris med bstan 'gro la phan pa rgya cher bskrun/ slar yang skye dgu'i dpal du sku bltams tshul ni/ yab lcags khung pad te dang yum rigs bzang ya rabs 7

pa'i chu bya lo'i cho 'phrul zla ba'i yar tshes gsum la rdo khog rdzu med chos lhas su sku 'khrungs/ de yang bltams pa'i tshe na sku lus drang por bsrangs/ spyan phyes/phru ma chos gos kyi tshul du mnabs te zhal nas o a ra pa tsa na dhiḥzhes lan bdun du brjod pa sgron tshe sogs der yod kun gyis gsal bor thos/ de dus nyid nas dad dang snying rje byang chub sems lhan skyes su mnga' zhing / theg pa chen po'i rigs sad pa'i rtags ma lus yongs su rdzogs/ dgung grangs gnyis la son skabs rta shul bla ma don rtogs sogs kyis gter chen las rab gling pa'i yang sprul du ngos 'dzin 'khrul med mdzad/ de yang las gling rang gi sku skye phyi mar ngos 'dzin mi 'gyur ba'i rtags bdun gyis bstan te/ gnas mi 'gyur chos kyi 'byung gnas suḥ mdangs mi 'gyur g.yu yi mtsho mo laḥrigs mi 'gyur padma'i sdong po'i rtseraḥ sngags sna nam sprul pa'i khye'u mchogaḥlo mi 'gyur mkha' lding bya la bltamasaḥ lus mi 'gyur lag mthil mkha' 'gro'i dalaḥ ngag mi 'gyur sde snod rgya mchos brgyanaḥ sems mi 'gyur chos sku'i rang ngo 'phrodaḥces dang / o rgyan chen pos/ de 'og mdo khams smad du a yi mingaḥ sde snod 'dzin pa bya yi lo ba 'byung ཿzhes dang /rdo grub kun bzang gzhan phan gyi ma 'ongs lung bstan las/ gser rnga dam lha yi bla lung du/ / dpal o rgyan gyi sprul pa 'jigs med mtshan/ / 'khor rnam bzhi'i byang sems sde tshogs la/ / chos mdo sngags kyi bstan pa nyi bzhin gsal/ / khong 'gro don sa brtan spo la reg/ / 'khor dag pa'i gdul bya gas bcur khyab/ / der 'brel kun bde chen sa la 'god/ / ces sogs sngon byon dam pa mang pos rigs rus dgung snying dang ston 'khor phrin las kyi 377

che ba rnams 'khrul med kyi lung gis gsal bor bstan/ dgung grangs drug bdun nas 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge bsgrubs pas klog sogs cher bslab ma dgos par byang chub par ma zad gsung rab dgongs 'grel gyi don 'ol spyi tsam thugs su chud/ rtsed mo'i tshul du gter 'don pa dang / 'khrul med kyi mngon shes smra ba/ o rgyan chen po dang / zhabs dkar pa/ kong sprul rnams kyi drung nas gdams pa mnos pa'i tshul dran pa sogs dam pa'i yon tan shin tu mang ngo / /dgung lo bcu bzhi par brag rdzong mkhan po bsod nams rin chen las rab du byung ste/ thos bsam sbyang ba rgya cher byas nas gzhung rnams gzhan la 'chad pa dang mi pham sgrub thabs 'od gsal theg pa'i nying khu/ 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i phyag mtshan ral gri la phyi nang gsang gsum gyi bstod pa/spobs pa'i gter brgyad sgrub thabs kyi man ngag sogs mdzad/ dgung lo bco brgyad par gangs ldan dben pa'i ri sul rdza stod lcang ma sgar du byon nas yongs kyi bshes gnyen mkhan chen thub bstan chos 'phel dpal bzang po de da mnyes pa gsum gyis bsten te/ thun mong thun min gyi gtsug lag spyi nga / khyad par du gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i dbang khrid man ngag gi phyag bzhes dang / 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i lam gyi cha lag bcas bum pa nga byo'i tshul du bstsal te sras kyi thu bor mnga' gsol/ de dus zla ba du mar bza' btung gnyis kyi tshab tu zho tsam dang / dur khrod kyi gos dag mnabs nas dka' spyad tshad med mdzad de gzhung chen lnga la gsan sbyang mthar ru phyinar gnyis la babs tshe rje de nyid las bsnyen par rdzogs te da lta'i bar sor nga sngags gsum gyi bslab sdom dam tshig phra mo las kyang ma 'das pas gsum 7

ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa chen por gyur/ de yang zhabs brtan gsol 'debs las/thun mong thun min shes bya'i gnas la mkhas/ / sor byang sngags kyi sdom pa dag pas btsun/ / phyin drug rim gnyis rnal 'byor brtan pas bzang / /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i sgron me zhes gsungs pa ni don dang mthun pa yin no/gzhan yang snga rjes su ma ṇi bla ma padma sirnyi/ dpal sprul nam mkha' 'jigs med/ bod pa sprul sku mdo sngags bstan pa'i nyi ma sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po las dbang khrid man ngag du ma nyams su bzhes/ de dag rnams kyang bsam sbyor gnyis kyis zol med du bsten pas thugs zin gyi sras su gyuradus 'gyur gyi dbang gis dri med rgyal bstan rin po che snum zad kyi mar me lta bur gyur pa'i tshe na/ khong gis ri sul rnams su snying po'i sgrub pa la gzhol ba dang / skal ldan rnams la dbang khrid gnang ba/ bstan bcos mang po rtsom pa/ gnas mchog tsitta ma ṇi ru 'khor rnams la 'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i dbang bstsal nas bsnyen pa dung phyir re khas len du bcugs pa sogs mdzad nas yang dar bstan pa'i dbu btsugs/ de ni khrag 'thung bdud 'joms rdo rje'i zhal nas/ da skabs nas mi lo brgya tsam nas/ / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ming tsam byed/ / de rjes kyi dus kyi skabs shig na/ / sna nam pas sngags kyi bstan pa skyong / / grub mtha' yi me ro slong srid na/ / snga 'gyur gyi bstan pa ches cher gsal/ / zhes pa de yin no/ bod rab bcu drug pa'i lcags sprel lo'i tshes bcu la sngon gter chen khrag 'thung bdud 'joms gling pa'i slob ma 'ja' lus pa bcu gsum byon pa'i gdan sa gser shod bla ma rung du lnga rig nang bstan slob gling gsar btsugs mdzad/ de nas bzung 'khor gyi 'du ba na re las kyang nyin re je rgyas su song nas gtan sdod slob ma khri lhag 'byang 7ba

te 'dzam gling chos kyi lte gnas su gyur/ slob ma rnams la mdo sngags thun mong gi rig gnas spyi dang / gzhung bka' pod lnga/ grub mtha' chen po brgyad kyi lta grub/ khyad du rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i khrigs chod dang thod rgal gyi nyams len sogs bshad khrid dbang lung rgyun ldan du gnangs/'dul ba lung dang rgyud sde dpang por byas te sku srog la ma ltos par bstan pa dag ther mdzad/ kun mkhyen mi pham rgya mchos ye shes sgyu ma'i skus rjes su bzung ste rig stong gdod ma'i rang gshes mngon du gyur/ gangs ljongs mdo dbus khams gsum dang rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga sogs su byon nas skye 'gro bgrang las 'das pa la bde ba can du skye ba'i phrin las rgya cher mdzad/ gnas chen rnams su byon skabs zab gter 'don pa dang rdo la zhabs rjes 'jog pa sogs grub pa'i mdzad spyod sna tshogs kun gyi mthong yul du gyur/ gzhan yang rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul dang / bal yul/ a ri/ dbyin ji/ hpha ran seca na ta/ 'jar pan/ 'brug yul sogs phyi'i rgyab khab mang por zhabs kyis bcags te gangs can phyag na padmo'i gtsos mkhas grub mang po'i bla mar bkur ba dang / gdul bya 'bum ther du ma smin grol gyi lam la bkod nas bstan 'gro'i don rlabs chen mdzad/ re zhig gi dus na skye 'gro kun gyi phan bde la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dam sri zhig yod pa de lha dang bla ma chos skyong rnams kyis bkas bskul ba la brten nas nyid kyis mngon spyod kyi las la bkod/ 'dul 'dzin gyi mkhan sprul bzhi brgya lhag skyed sring byas nas ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i sdes sa gsum khyab pa lta bur mdzad/ mdor na lhod med kyi thugs bskyed zab mos ris med bstan 'gro yongs la phan bde'i dri char blanadī ༵ ru spel bzhin 'gyur med g.yung drug gi khri la zhabs zung rdo rje'i ri mo

g.yo med du bzhugs nas rtag pa rgyun du theg dgu chos kyi 'khor lo skal ldan dpal du bskor bzhin legs so/ /gsung skyes slob ma'i tshogs la/ mchog sprul lung rtogs rgya mtsho/ rme sprul bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/ sku sring mkha' 'gro ma me sgron/ mi 'gyur dpal sgron gyi rnam 'phrul mu med ye shes mtsho mo/ mkhan po tshul khrims blo grosamakhan po 'chi med rig 'dzin/ mkhan po bstan 'dzin nor bu/ mkhan po bsod nams dar rgyas/ mkhan po ye shes phun tshogs/ nyag mkhan po tshul khrims sogs bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu gser ri tshar du dngar ba lta bu'i dam pamang pos mdo sngags kyi bstan pa rin po che tshul bzhin du 'dzin skyong spelagasum mdzad bzhin bzhugs so/ /da lam dpar du 'khod pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po gnas lugs rang byung gi rgyud ces bya ba 'di ni/ ji skad du/ don la nges pa'i gdeng rnyed na/ /thugs nas chu gter 'bum phrag rdol/ / zhes gsung pa bzhin du/ khrag 'thung bdud 'joms gling pa nyid nang rig pa'i ye shes la dbang 'byor pa'i stobs kyis theg pa mtha' dag mkhyen pa'i shes rab phyogs med du rgyas nas zab gter chos kyi mdzod khang ngang gis rdol ba las 'di ni rgya che ba dgongs gter gyi tshul du gtan la phabs pa'i gsung khyad 'phags sheg go/ /de yang sgyu 'phrul le'u dang po'i nang du gsungs pa ltar rang snang ye shes gcig gis rol ba las ston pa kun bzang mtsho skyes rdo rje nyid la 'khor byang chub sems dpa' bgrang las 'das pa gnyis su med par so sor snang nas 'khor rnams kyis gtso bo la dri ba dang dris lan gyi tshul du gsungs pa zhig na/ brjod bya ni/ spyir theg pa rim dgu'i nyams len rnams rags bsdus 1

nas 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i gzhi lam 'bras gsum la mtha' gzhan du 'dzin pa'i dogs pa rnams rig pa zhib mos yang dag par bsal zhing mtha' gcig tu kho thag bcad yod pa dang / sgrub phyogs nas rdzogs pa chen po'i gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi rnam bzhag rnams cha tshang don zab pa zhal gsal zhing go slar rgyas bsdus su gsungs yod/ de las 'phros pa'i sgo nas zab mo dbu ma'i skabs kyi tha snyad rtog btags kyi rnam bzhag 'jog tshul dang don dam khas len kun bral gyi gtan la phab tshul skabs skabs su zhib rgyas su gsungs yod/ mthar yang gsang rdo rje snying po'i thun min gyi gnad gsang sogs bstan nas skal ldan rnams sku bzhi'i rgyal sar tshe 'di nyid la dbugs 'byin mdzad pa'i gdams pa rmad du byung ba zhig yin no/ / de yang kun mkhyen mi pham rgya mchos bdud 'joms rin po la bskur ba'i 'phrin lasanyid dam pa'i gsang khrid zer ba dpe thang gcig mthong bas chos skad gsar pa mang yang thams cad gnad dang ldan pa 'od gsal rdo rje'i snying po'i rang lugs slong ba'i rdo rje'i gsung du 'dugs snyam gus pa snying nas 'phel/ zhes gsungs yod pas snga 'gyur rnying ma'i mdo rgyud sems gsum gyi dka' ba'i gnad rnams dang zab mo stong pa nyid kyi don la go ba cung zad skye bar 'dod pa rnams kyis dang po gzhung 'di nyid la gzhi byas te thos bsam bsgom gsum brtson pas 'jug na tshul bzhin du rtogs nus pas/ 'di ni zab gnad ga gi don gyi go ba 'tshol ba la srog lta bu'am mig lta bu yin pas bskal bzang gi skyes bu rnams gnas 'di la 'jug par rigs so/ /bdud 'joms dpe tshogs su 'khod pa'i gnas lugs rang byung gi rgyud

bzhin nor bu 7'jigs med phun tshogs 'byung gnas dpal bzang po mchog dang gter gsar bstan pa'i bdag po rgyal sras rta mgrin dbang rgyalamachog sprul lung rigs rgya mtsho rnams la yab rje gter chen bla ma'i zab gter 'di dag 'grems spel bya ba la dgongs 'char zhus tshe thugs bab dang gongs gnang dbugs dbyung mdzad pas kho bos dpar du bskrun pa las rang blo gang shar du spel pa min nges gyis des na gnad brgya gcig tu sgril ba'i bdag nyid/ zab gsang rdo rje snying po'i bcud thig chos sku'i rang zhal 'jal ba'i nye lam/ rig stong gdod ma rtogs pa'i thabs mchog 'di nyid dang du blang bar bya 'os so/ /slar smras pa/gdod nas rab zhi gnyug ma don gyi dbyings/ /mi g.yo rgyal ba kun bzang mtsho skyes rjes/ /gnyis med byang sems bgrang yas 'khor tshogs la/ /gnas lugs rgyud kyi rgyal po'i rang sgra bsgrags/ /bar du khro lod bdud 'joms he ru ga'i/ /chos nyid mngon sum snang ba'i shar cha las/ /rdol ba'i dgongs gter zag med bdud rtsi'i mdzod/ /skal ldan yid kyi bum pa bzang por bstsal/ /theg dgu'i nyams len gnas lugs rang byung rgyud/ /3

rgyas bsdus gnad tshang brjod bya'i don zab pa/ /'di 'dra'i gzhung bzang srid pa gsum na dkon/ /zab gsang myur lam mchog gi man ngag 'di/ /dang po'i lus can dka' ba'i gnad grol dang / /'phags pa'i skye bo dgyes pa'i mchod sprin du/ /rnam dag sems kyi brtson pa drag pos spel/ /'dir 'bad dge ba'i bla ma'i zhabs pad brtan/ /gang gi thugs zin gdams pas yid dbang sim/ /zab chos phrin las 'dzam gling tha grur khyab/ /'brel kun gdod ma'i gzhi ru sangs rgyas shog /ces pa ni bod rab byung bcu bdun pa'i chu mo lug ste rang lo nyer lnga par kun 'joms nor bu'i lding khang gsar pa ru 'go brtsam zhing slad nas phyir pha yul gseramo'i ljongs su phyin te gsang chen 'od skur grol ba'i dben khrod du bdag cag gi ston palha las babs pa'i dus bzang dgu ba'i nyer gnyis la 'du gsum pa lcags khung ngagadabang blo bzang gis bris pa dge'o/ /4

ched du brjod pa'i gtam/deb 'di nyid dpesbun bya ba la yis yan men dang /(tho77)nga shang hung /(1añdza1) shang su'u hong /(rshalosmo) kren hru'u wu'u(lkokṣa 7zhi) ko'o kra'o wun khyim tshang (lkopho'isprongaphrag྾)la sogasakyisapal 'byor gyi rogasaskyor gang mang gnang bas/ 'dir snying nas bsngo smon nga thugasarje che zhu'o/ /3 5
